raw.title: Regional Director, Client Engagement
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets, the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 350+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We are bringing Client Engagement together as a single global function under our Global Head of Client Engagement. We are hiring Regional Directors to lead it on the ground. You will own retention, adoption and growth for your region (EMEA or the Americas), lead a team of Client Engagement Managers across a tiered coverage model, and turn client insight into action across the business.

This is a role for a proven CS or AM leader who wants to scale a function. You will inherit a strong foundation, shape the next stage, and be accountable for commercial outcomes: gross and net revenue retention, product adoption, and the health of our most important client relationships.

What You’ll Work On

Every day is different, but here is the kind of work you will lead:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach and develop a regional team of Strategic CEMs, Senior CEMs and Client Engagement Managers across the whole region, and the managers beneath you as the team grows.

  • Run a tiered coverage model: Strategic CSMs for our most important accounts, Senior CSMs for key accounts, and CSMs for the wider base. Define clear roles, service levels and career paths at each level.

  • Hire, onboard and train to a rapid growth plan, with a strong bench of internal successors.

Retention, Adoption & Growth

  • Own regional gross revenue retention (GRR), with clear early-warning signals and remediation plans for at-risk accounts.

  • Drive seat-level adoption: activate and re-activate users, build champion networks, and embed 9fin in each client’s daily workflow.

  • Lead adoption of our newest products, including 9fin AI and Private 9fin, with client-specific programmes and measurable usage goals.

  • Design role and client-specific adoption metrics that forecast usage trends, so the team drives usage proactively.

  • Partner with Account Management and Relationship Managers on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership at each stage of the client lifecycle.

Strategy & Operating Model

  • Translate the global Client Engagement strategy into a regional plan, with the playbooks, success plans and lifecycle programmes to execute it.

  • Use health scoring and usage data to decide where the team spends its time, and to move accounts between coverage tiers as their needs change.

  • Report regularly on regional KPIs to global leadership: retention, adoption, health, renewals and expansion pipeline.

Voice of the Client

  • Represent clients in conversations with Product, Engineering, Data and Editorial, backing requests with evidence such as the accounts affected, the ARR at stake and the workflow impact.

  • Work with our Forward Deployed team on strategic accounts, setting shared success criteria and feeding what you learn back into the product.

  • Build executive relationships with senior stakeholders at your region’s most important clients.

Operational Excellence

  • Use Salesforce, our analytics tools and client engagement platforms to make the team more proactive, with automation where it frees up time for high-value work.

  • Keep playbooks, client communications and dashboards current, and create feedback loops that improve the client experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 months: a clear picture of your region’s accounts, risks and team, and a regional plan agreed with the Global Head of Client Engagement.

  • Within 6 months: accounts assigned and covered under the tiered model, with health scoring in use and a visible improvement in early-warning response.

  • Within 12 months: measurable gains in regional retention, adoption and AI and Private 9fin usage, and a team with the capacity and leadership depth to keep scaling.

Requirements

This role will be a great fit if you have:

Experience & Expertise

  • 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or related client-facing roles in Capital Markets, Enterprise B2B SaaS or Financial Data, including 3+ years leading teams.

  • Experience managing AMs, CSMs, AEs or building the layer of leadership beneath you, ideally across more than one region or client segment.

  • A track record of scaling or structuring a CS or AM function through a period of fast growth.

  • Strong understanding of global financial markets, and credibility with buyside, sellside and advisory clients.

Commercial Acumen

  • Proven success driving retention, adoption and expansion in enterprise accounts, ideally accountable for a portfolio of $50m in ARR.

  • Comfort being measured on GRR, NRR and adoption, and designing the KPIs, dashboards and forecasting that support them.

  • Experience working alongside sales and account management on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership between teams.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent people leadership: you coach, develop and hold a high bar for high-performing teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside 9fin and at clients.

  • The judgement to prioritise competing demands and to use data to decide where the team focuses.

Bonus Points

  • Existing relationships in the Leveraged Finance, Debt Capital Markets or Restructuring community.

  • Experience in a high-growth fintech or data provider, or with seat-based professional data products.

  • Experience driving adoption of AI products or working with embedded or forward deployed teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, product analytics and client engagement platforms.

Why Join Us?

You will join a fast-moving, ambitious team helping to power the largest financial market in the world. This role offers the chance to lead a regional Client Engagement team at a pivotal moment: with a clear global strategy, a product that clients rely on daily, and the mandate to shape how we retain and grow our client base for years to come.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help expand the breadth and depth of the 9fin platform.

You’ll join a cross-functional product and engineering team solving complex, high-value problems for professionals across global debt markets, spanning AI-powered workflows, financial data and analysis, transaction intelligence, document management, and other emerging product areas.

You’ll help shape products used by teams at leading investment banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisory businesses - sophisticated users working with large volumes of complex information, where speed, accuracy, and trust are critical.

It’s a chance to shape frontier AI-native products inside a company using technology to transform one of the world’s largest financial markets.

What you'll work on


Product & Design Strategy

  • Partner with customers, Product Managers, engineers, and subject matter experts to shape product vision and design strategy — not just how it looks, but how it works and why it matters.

  • Focused on trust and precision: you think in edge cases, error states, and ambiguity, especially where AI is involved.

  • AI-native in how you work: generative AI is a natural part of your process, from research to prototyping to stress-testing ideas.

  • A natural prototyper: you find the fastest way to make an idea tangible, whether that’s AI tools, Figma, code, or a pencil sketch.

  • Energised by a blank page: you thrive defining something new and iterating quickly through ambiguity.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our Platform engineering team is growing up. Two engineering teams, Developer Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, build the foundations every 9fin engineer and product squad relies on. We now need a senior Product Manager to sit across both and bring product discipline to how the platform is shaped.

Today, Platform runs on speed and engineering instinct. You will help it work more like a product team. You will own the upfront work of problem definition, internal user research, prioritisation and success criteria, so engineers can focus on building the right things. Engineers are your customers: you will interview them, compare solutions, synthesise what you learn, and turn it into a clear roadmap. You will also own quarterly strategy and priorities planning across both teams, balancing operational and support demand against building the self-service platform of the future.

You will work closely with two engineering leads and their teams, and partner with product squads across the organisation who depend on the platform. Day-to-day triage will largely stay with platform engineers, so you can focus on the decisions that matter most. This is a high-autonomy role with direct access to engineering leadership and real scope to define what “platform as a product” means at 9fin. You will also make the value of platform work visible, using data to show where it makes teams more effective and celebrating the wins.

Key responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for the platform product squad.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from engineering surveys, interviews, and usage data to craft clear problem statements, articulating root causes in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Run structured discovery with internal engineering customers - interviews, usage analysis, survey synthesis - to understand developer workflows, identify friction, and build confidence before investing.

  • Impact driven: Define and align the team around key outcomes and effectively prioritise across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, distinguishing urgent requests from long-term investments that benefit multiple teams.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics that capture platform value and make the impact of platform work visible across the engineering org.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower your squads to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside your team - including product and feature teams who depend on you.

  • Stakeholder Management: Work with internal engineering stakeholders to gather the right input, ensuring they have the information to effectively represent the platform team within their own areas.

About You

You have an outstanding ability to think on your feet and tackle intellectually challenging problems. You are highly analytical and comfortable using data to make decisions.

raw.title: Executive Assistant - Chief Product Officer & Chief Technology Officer
raw.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


How you'll empower our tech and product leadership

You be a strategic partner and a vital force multiplier for our Chief Product Officer, Tom (CPrO) and incoming Chief Technology Officer (CTO). By anticipating their needs, shaping their organisational engagement, and prioritising their diaries against company objectives, you will help turn their strategic vision into real momentum across the Product & Technology teams.

  • Owning the operating rhythm: You will proactively manage the executives' time and diaries, utilising your knowledge of Product Development Lifecycles and Engineering to effectively balance urgent requests with important strategic priorities.

  • Driving strategic communications: You will draft, shape, and constructively challenge key messaging from the executives, ensuring communications are clear, consistent, and land successfully with various audiences.

  • Preparing with a point of view: You will go beyond basic preparation by synthesising information, highlighting crucial details, and recommending decisions ahead of key meetings and board sessions.

  • Being the ear to the ground: You will stay attuned to team sentiment and blockers across Product & Technology, bringing insights to the executives early and advising on the best response.

  • Fostering an AI-native culture: You will partner with the executives and other Executive Assistants to design impactful cultural moments, such as hackathons and Town Hall meetings, ensuring momentum continues long after the events conclude.

  • Running the Product & Tech engine: You will oversee logistics for the Product & Tech Leadership forum, manage fast-changing schedules, and monitor asynchronous Slack conversations to highlight matters needing executive attention.

  • Delivering impactful projects and events: You will own and run projects on behalf of the executives from planning to delivery, while also managing the logistics for internal and external events, offsites, and team socials.


You should apply if...

  • You are an experienced Executive Assistant: You have previously supported Product, Tech, or Engineering leaders within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proactive forward-thinking is your natural state: You excel at thinking multiple steps ahead, actioning potential next steps before the executives have even considered them.

  • You're a critical prioritisation partner: You are a critical thinker who has the ability to challenge executives on their priorities, messaging, or plans to keep them focused on what matters.

  • You use AI as your teammate: You are confident leveraging AI tools, effective prompting, and automation to redefine how you work and find smarter ways to execute.

  • You're the master of diaries and complex logistics: You have excellent time-management skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a proven track record managing fast-changing schedules and team events under tight deadlines.

  • You have strong industry and business acumen: You understand how product and engineering organisations deliver, enabling you to help leaders balance the urgent with the important.

  • You're an empathetic, high-EQ communicator: You influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, read how change lands across an organisation, and adapt your communication style seamlessly.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £60,000 - £75,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £60K – £75K • Offers Equity

raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As an Account Executive on our Mid Market team, you’ll help ambitious businesses solve complex financial challenges across borders by bringing Airwallex’s global financial platform to more customers.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and territory planning through negotiation and close.

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and understand their business needs.

  • Partner across teams to shape solutions spanning spend management and related products.

  • Manage your pipeline carefully and deliver accurate forecasting through disciplined CRM usage.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound business development and 1+ year in a closing sales role.

  • Experience selling a spend management tool or similar financial technology product.

  • A track record of strong sales performance and meeting targets.

  • Experience owning a full sales cycle, from prospecting through close.

  • The ability to understand complex customer requirements and craft solutions across multiple products.

  • Experience developing and executing territory plans.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, particularly in meetings with multiple stakeholders and CXO-level audiences.

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Experience using CRM systems consistently for pipeline management and forecasting.

  • Willingness to represent Airwallex at client meetings and events, with some travel required.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You say what you mean. You’re direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You’re motivated by working alongside people whose ambition pushes you to raise your own bar.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

 

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth.

  • Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance.

  • Partner with the business, Regulatory Legal and Regulatory Compliance teams on expansion into and launches in new markets across the UK and EMEA, including regulatory mapping, entity and licensing considerations, and corporate governance requirements.

  • Align Airwallex’s policies, procedures and corporate governance frameworks across jurisdictions, with particular focus on UK requirements.

  • Draft, review and negotiate referral agreements, marketing and sponsorship agreements, and other commercial arrangements, ensuring risks are appropriately managed and documented.

  • Advise on marketing, advertising and promotions, including claims, disclosures, digital campaigns, co-marketing and referral programmes, while supporting the review of customer-facing materials for legal and regulatory compliance.

  • Coordinate and manage outside counsel on specialised matters in the UK and across EMEA, ensuring advice is high-quality, cost-effective and aligned to Airwallex’s risk appetite and business goals.

  • Use technology and AI-enabled tools, including templates, playbooks, contract lifecycle tools and knowledge bases, to increase the speed, consistency and quality of legal work.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Qualification as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another UK jurisdiction, and in good standing with the relevant professional body.

  • Proven experience in financial services and corporate law, preferably gained at a fast-growing technology or fintech company and/or a top-tier law firm.

  • Demonstrated interest in financial services regulation and the fintech industry, with willingness to go deep on payments, e-money, money services and related regulatory topics in the UK and EMEA.

  • In-depth knowledge of, or strong familiarity with, the UK legal and business environment, including how UK legislation, FCA requirements and cross-border rules impact fintech and payments businesses.

  • Proven experience drafting and negotiating corporate and commercial agreements, with strong written and verbal communication skills that make complex issues clear to non-lawyers.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Compliance, Risk and Marketing, across time zones.

  • Demonstrated capability in managing and leading outside counsel, including scoping work, controlling costs and consolidating advice into clear recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical, business-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting fundraising transactions, M&A or strategic investments, including due diligence and deal execution, ideally in a technology or fintech context.

  • Prior in-house experience in a fintech, payments or broader financial services company, particularly one operating across the UK and multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Experience advising on legal issues related to marketing, advertising and promotions, including digital marketing, performance marketing, referral programmes and brand partnerships.

  • Exposure to UK financial services regulatory frameworks, including the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, the Payment Services Regulations 2017, the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, FCA rules and guidance, and applicable financial promotions requirements.

  • Experience partnering with Regulatory Legal, Regulatory Compliance or licensing teams on market expansion initiatives and regulatory change.

  • Comfort using technology, AI and legal operations tools to increase the speed and quality of legal work, for example playbooks, templates, contract lifecycle tools or knowledge bases.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

Legal sits at the heart of the decisions that shape how Airwallex grows. This team backs the builders transforming us into a generational financial company, working alongside product, sales, and business partners every step of the way. You'll help shape a global licensing footprint most fintechs wish they had, while keeping our brand and data architecture best-in-class for customers entering the agentic economy and its regulatory demands. The hard part is helping the business move fast on product, revenue, and new-market expansion without compromising the discipline that protects the moat.

It's a team for lawyers, strategists, and licensing specialists with commercial instincts, sharp judgment, and an obsession with customer-first outcomes. If you want to guide executive decisions and help build the licensing, structure, and judgment behind what comes next, this is where legal has real leverage.

How you'll make impact

Technical Support helps customers and internal teams get the most from Airwallex’s products after integration. You’ll investigate complex technical issues, turn recurring problems into practical guidance, and help coordinate clear responses when incidents affect customers.

  • Support developers, merchants and internal teams with post-integration issues, providing technical guidance, consulting and best practices.

  • Investigate issues across code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints by designing and running test scenarios.

  • Configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products to reproduce issues and support effective resolution.

  • Communicate technical issues clearly to customers and internal teams, identifying irregularities and unexpected behaviour in Airwallex products and services.

  • Create practical technical resources, including sample code, log-searching guidance and FAQs, for customers and internal teams.

  • Coordinate communication and responses between clients, internal stakeholders and senior leadership during global incident management.

  • Support occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage as the business requires.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in programming, technical support, implementation or a related role.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and appropriately with customers and internal teams.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong prioritisation, organisation and attention to detail when managing multiple urgent issues in parallel.

  • Sufficient technical knowledge to communicate effectively with Engineering and Product teams.

  • A strong commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

  • The ability to learn new technologies and products quickly.

  • Experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, PHP, C#, JavaScript or shell scripting.

  • Familiarity with web technologies, HTTP and HTTPS.

  • Experience with REST, JSON, SOAP and SQL.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk and Grafana.

  • Willingness to participate in occasional weekend and holiday on-call coverage.

Preferred

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

Performance Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Allica is building out its growth function, based around talented, empowered and autonomous individuals who will be responsible for product-based customer acquisition using a combination of channels to meet objectives set across the business. You will get an opportunity to work with different teams across the business including product squads, distribution, engineers and operations to deliver on Allica’s mission of becoming the UK’s most recommended business bank.

We are rare amongst banks in that our senior leadership team have backgrounds at worldleading fintechs, which shows in their active engagement in both the strategic and execution elements of our rapidly scaling organisation. Because we are working on one of the last untapped fintech opportunities, in a new team it will mean that we're often working on entirely new challenges and unpicking complexity as we move along. No two days are ever the same.

Role Description

The Performance Marketing Manager at Allica Bank is responsible for scaling customer growth across our Business Bank Account and Lending products while maintaining an efficient CAC:LTV. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Working closely with the team,you’ll bring strong analytical rigour, marketing instinct, and a bias for action - using data, automation, and AI to drive performance at scale.

Principal Accountabilities

Performance Marketing Execution & Strategy

  • Lead hands-on campaign execution and strategy across Paid Social (with a focus on Meta Ads), Paid Search, PMax, and other key channels. 

  • Optimise creative, user journeys, campaign structures, and targeting, with structured experiments & test-and-learn roadmaps to scale results efficiently. 

  • Plan and deliver acquisition initiatives that balance near-term results with long-term growth goals.

Data & Reporting 

  • Ensure all activity is tracked comprehensively and maintain accurate reporting of campaigns and creative. 

  • Provide clear and actionable recommendations by analysing performance data.

Team & Vendor Management 

  • Manage and develop a small team, fostering ownership and executional excellence.  Oversee agency and partner performance, ensuring alignment with KPIs and quality standards.

Marketing Technology & Automation 

  • Set up and optimise workflows and integrations using tools like HubSpot and Zapier.

  • Use AI and automation to improve speed, scale, and campaign effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Work closely with Brand, Product, Sales, Data, and Compliance to ensure aligned, compliant acquisition. 

  • Contribute to go-to-market planning and unify performance with brand-led growth.

Personal Attributes & Experience Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years hands-on experience executing and scaling high-performing Performance Marketing campaigns, ideally with a strong focus on Meta Ads and Google ads within Fintech. 

  • Owned and delivered robust test-and-learn processes at scale, with specific focus on creative testing systems and user journey testing. 

  • Strong modelling and analysis skills using Excel and other analytics & visualisation tools.

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tagging, and offline conversion tracking, with experience optimising campaigns to pipeline events. 

  • Familiar with HubSpot, Zapier, and basic no-code automation. 

  • Experience managing at least 1-2 direct reports and external partners. 

  • Working proficiency with SQL is desirable

  • Exposure to Financial Promotions or regulated industries is desirable

Mindset & Working Style 

  • Analytical and data-driven - comfortable making decisions from performance metrics.

  • Proactive and self-starting working with speed and autonomy. 

  • Use AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency and results. 

  • A fast learner who thrives in high-growth, fast-moving environments. 

  • Motivated by impact and passionate about helping established businesses thrive through better banking.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

raw.title: Senior Fire, Health and Safety Consultant
raw.description:
Senior Fire, Health & Safety Consultant | Hybrid | London & Surrounding | Permanent | Competitive Package

 

At Ark Workplace Risk, we empower our clients to confidently manage risk, compliance, and safety through a trusted partnership built on expert knowledge, innovative solutions, and proactive guidance and insight.  

 

About Ark Workplace Risk:  

  • Proven Expert Knowledge: With over 30 years of experience and a trusted reputation among 200+ UK organisations, we provide workable solutions that align with our clients' organisational and business goals, as well as regulatory requirements.  
  • Industry-Leading Software: Our innovative tools streamline risk and compliance management, putting clients in control and enabling them to demonstrate accountability to stakeholders.  
  • Insight-Driven Solutions: As industry thought leaders, we provide actionable insights into emerging legislation, guidance, and industry trends, ensuring court-readiness for their business.  
  • Responsive Partnership: From every day, business-as-usual guidance to urgent, critical, complex, and contentious scenarios, we work in partnership with clients, becoming their trusted advisor and solution provider, whenever and wherever they need us most. 

 

About the Role  

 

Reporting into a Team Leader (each team is circa 5-7) and up to the Director of Professional Services, you will be joining a market leading team of professionals to undertake risk assessments and advise on fire, health and safety matters at a variety of buildings including mid-high rise buildings, to our established portfolio of clients across a variety of segments, including, residential, commercial and retail.  

 

Responsibilities:  

  •  Undertake risk assessments including fire and health and safety, ensuring the fee earning target is met.   
  • Undertake various fire, health and safety assignments within your competency.  
  • Deliver client reports within the agreed SLA, in accordance with a forensic and pragmatic approach to ensure the Ark 'Gold Standard' is achieved.   
  • Design health and safety site management systems where required, specific to client requirements.  
  • Undertake onsite briefings and advise on risk management improvements.  
  • Work collaboratively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.  
  • Work with other consultants to ensure we are constantly sharing knowledge across the team.  
  • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of controlling risks, compliances etc in relation to our online management system QUOODA®  
  • Remain up-to-date with the Technical and regulatory requirements impacting our clients.    

  

The ideal candidate will have:  

  •  At least 5+ years' fire, health & safety risk assessment experience within the built environment in residential and/or commercial buildings 
  • Good working knowledge of Approved Document B 
  • Good working knowledge of BS 9999 / 9997 
  • Education suitable to be competent to carry out Fire and Health & Safety risk assessments on seven or more floors 
  • The ability to undertake Fire Risk Assessments and General Risk Assessments at the same time 
  • Articulate and clear communicators and report writing abilities as well as a comprehensive understanding of current UK regulations 

 

 Qualifications 

  • Must have NEBOSH General Certificate in Health & Safety or equivalent as minimum. 
  • Recognised fire safety memberships e.g. AIFireE, MIFireE, GIFireE, MIFSM or MIFPO (ADVANTAGEOUS) 
  • Willing to apply for or have registered on any of the following fire risk assessors registers IFSM, FRACS, IFPO or IFE 

 

Why Work for Us  

 

Ark is a market leader providing an innovative suite of; Professional Service Solutions, Outsourcing and future-proofed Software and Analytics to mid/major organisations in the UK. With over 500 global and premium brands trusting Ark to deliver smarter Risk, Compliance, Safety. 

 

Reasons to join for us:

  • An attractive package and training bursary contract.
  • New game changing Building Safety software. 
  • Options to mentor others and management progression within Ark. 
  • Progress your career with continuous training and CPD opportunities. 
  • Ark is an innovative growing company that is recognised as a leader in safety within the built environment. 
  • Ark organises technical and knowledge sharing which is of enormous benefit to the Ark Professional Services Team. 

 

APPLY NOW

Do drop us your CV as we are always keen to connect with great talent.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Purpose of the role and role description

As we scale into 2027 and beyond, we're adding a Senior Recruiter in London to extend our reach into the world's most competitive hiring markets.

In this role, you'll own full-cycle recruiting across a range of functions, with a particular focus on building Attio's presence and network amongst GTM talent, specifically Sales, Success, Support and Marketing. You'll also play a role in connecting top talent to opportunities across Attio's global team, but primarily London and New York. You'll work closely with GTM Executives, our Hiring Managers and the Talent team, partnering on structured, calibrated hiring processes that consistently raise the bar.

This is a recruiting role for someone who recognises the impact of great hiring on company success and who see’s this as an opportunity to perfect the craft of calibration, engagement and network building to become one of the best in their field in this market.

Key candidate attributes

  • Skills

    • Full cycle skills for briefings, partnering, calibration and networking

    • Role launch design and sourcing strategy execution across multiple channels

    • Candidate pipeline management and data hygiene

  • Experience

    • High-growth AI, B2B SaaS or tech startup recruitment experience either in agency or in house

    • Proven track record hiring across IC and manager level hiring. Bonus for exec

    • Deep familiarity with talent networks [GTM] and building teams across London and NYC.

  • Behaviours

    • Resilient - able to maintain momentum in a market where the bar is genuinely high, and sees that bar as an opportunity rather than a blocker

    • Resourceful - finds creative paths to candidates, doesn't rely on inbound

    • Proactive - surfaces ideas, spots gaps, doesn't wait to be directed

    • High agency - treats every open role like their own problem to solve

    • Facilitator, not the hero - understands that great recruiting is hiring manager-led; their job is to calibrate, enable and accelerate

    • Evangelism - deep belief in what Attio is building

Hiring process and hiring panel

Stage 1 - Introduction

  • Motivations, market background, understanding of high-bar recruiting environments.

Stage 2 — Track Record

  • Deep dive into recruiting track record. Roles closed, hiring bar held, sourcing methods, and how they have operated in high-growth and competitive US markets.

Stage 3 — Panel Interview

  • Working with Hiring managers, commercial judgement, market understanding, existing networks, working style, Talent team.

Stage 4 — Executive Interview

  • Mission alignment, trajectory, and final calibration on the type of talent hire Attio needs

Compensation & Benefits

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • Private medical insurance through AXA

  • Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

raw.description:
About Us

Axelera AI is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor company headquartered in the Netherlands, building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration hardware and software (Metis and Europa product lines). We operate across the EU, the UK, Switzerland and the US, and are building a finance function ready to scale to public-company standards.

Position Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Office & Community Specialist to support our growing Bristol office. This is an initial 6-month contract opportunity, with part-time hours (6-8 hours per week) and an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys creating a welcoming office environment while supporting community initiatives and local office operations.

You will report directly to an Office & Community Lead (Erika), who is based in the Netherlands, and work closely together to ensure smooth day-to-day operations in Bristol as our newest office location is established.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership of local office activities, building connections with colleagues, and ensuring that everything behind the scenes runs smoothly.


What You'll Do

1) Office Operations

  • Be the local point of contact for day-to-day office needs and ensure the office remains well-organised, stocked, and ready to welcome employees and visitors: ensure clean, organized and safe work environment. Pick up and take action on requests related to the office and facility tasks directly with the external and internal parties.

2) Purchasing & Vendor Coordination

  • Manage purchases with local suppliers for office supplies and daily necessities.

  • Ensure smooth organisation of fruit deliveries and other regular office services, like cleaning and waste management.

  • Coordinate monthly grocery and coffee supply orders.

3) Community & Event Support

  • Help foster an engaging and welcoming workplace culture: work together with the local team and be present in the office.

  • Support onboarding activities: access control, badge assignment and desk preparation.

  • 3-4 times a year: Support local community-building initiatives, celebrations, workshops and office activities in Bristol. Research venues, make reservations, and assist with logistical arrangements for team dinners and gatherings.

Your profile:

  • Organized & Reliable: Able to prioritize tasks independently and maintain attention to detail in a dynamic environment.

  • People Person: Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proactive and service-oriented mindset.

  • Ownership: Comfortable taking initiative and ensuring local office activities are completed efficiently.

  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with Microsoft Office and quick to learn new digital tools and systems.

  • Professional background: Preferably prior experience in office administration, facility support, hospitality, or a similar role.

  • Right to work in the UK. Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.


What We Offer:

  • An open, creative culture that encourages innovation and collaboration, where freedom and responsibility go hand in hand.

  • The opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, international technology company.

  • A supportive and people-focused work environment where your contributions make a real impact.


Location & office presence:

This is a part-time role based in our Bristol office at Bull Wharf. You’ll be in the office two days a week, for 3–4 hours each day, within standard office hours (e.g. 9am–5pm). Some flexibility might be required now and then to accommodate office needs and events.

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

raw.title: Expression of Interest - Internships
raw.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Internship - Expression of Interest

We're always interested in hearing from exceptional students who want to work on the hardest problems in AI infrastructure - bringing novel accelerators to life, building the systems that orchestrate them, and charting the new territories of what heterogeneous compute can do.

There's no formal internship programme or fixed cycle here - internships happen when the need and the right person come together. This form is how we keep track of who to reach out to when that happens. If you think you have unique skills to contribute, or are studying or have experience in any of the following, we'd love to hear from you:

  • High-performance systems and low-level performance engineering

  • Inference infrastructure, orchestration, or distributed systems

  • Hardware bring-up, kernel development, or accelerator programming

  • Simulation, modelling, or workload design

This is a general interest form rather than an application for a specific internship. We review all submissions on an ongoing basis and will reach out when we see a strong match and the right opportunity comes up.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that the next generation of AI systems will emerge from models and hardware being optimised together. Today's model architectures have largely evolved around the capabilities of conventional GPUs, leaving significant opportunities unexplored as new accelerator architectures emerge. We are building infrastructure that allows models to be adapted to different computational substrates, rather than treating them as fixed algorithms that hardware must accommodate.

This role explores how model architectures and inference algorithms can be adapted to exploit heterogeneous hardware, creating specialised variants with different trade-offs between capability, latency, and cost. You will investigate transformations spanning numerics, sparsity, model structure, memory, and execution, alongside new algorithms designed around emerging accelerators. A central part of the work is developing automated approaches to these adaptations and rigorous evaluations that establish when the resulting models offer meaningful advantages.

What You'll Build

  • Develop hardware-aware transformations that adapt models to different accelerator architectures and execution environments.

  • Explore numerical, structural, and memory-related optimisations to create model variants with different capability, latency, and cost trade-offs.

  • Investigate new inference algorithms, including speculative decoding, designed to exploit heterogeneous computational resources.

  • Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants.

  • Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations.

What Sets You Apart

  • Deep understanding of modern LLM architectures, including attention mechanisms, model structure, and their implications for inference.

  • Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning.

  • Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms.

  • Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency.

  • Experience designing rigorous experiments to assess model quality, efficiency, and the effects of architectural modifications.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

About the Role

Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist.

This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build.

What You'll Build

  • Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments.

  • Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations.

  • Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models.

  • Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms.

  • Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance.

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing.

  • Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads.

  • Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust.

  • Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost.

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!


THE BRAND TEAM

The Brand Team is responsible for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, performance and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and exploration.

THE ROLE

Plan and deliver integrated marketing that builds the Carwow brand and drives results, from big campaigns to always-on activity.

You’ll own campaigns from brief to results, working across brand and performance so everything we put out works hard at every stage of the funnel. You’ll brief and manage in-house creatives and agency partners, as well as working closely with performance, CRM and content teams. You’ll also use data to shape the work and prove its impact as part of a performance-focused Marketing team. Most of your focus will be the UK, with some work supporting our team in Spain.

This is a 12-month contract with real ownership. In that time you’ll establish test and learn plans across our marketing stack, run flagpole campaigns for new launches and leave behind ways of working that last beyond your time with us.

  • Manage campaign budgets and keep spend accurately tracked.

  • Support our team in Spain to adapt campaigns for their market.

  • Find and test new ways of working, including AI, to plan and deliver faster.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in marketing, in-house or agency, ideally at a consumer brand or scale-up.

  • A track record of integrated campaigns that delivered commercial results, across brand and performance.

  • Strong knowledge of ATL and digital channels, including TV, OOH, Meta, YouTube and paid search.

  • Experience briefing and managing creative and media agencies.

  • Comfortable with data: reading results, running tests and turning insight into action.

  • Confident managing budgets and tracking spend.

  • Hands-on use of AI in your marketing work, and a clear view on where it helps and where it doesn’t.

  • Strong stakeholder management, adapting your style for different teams and levels.

  • Able to get up to speed quickly and deliver from the start.

  • Organised and calm under pressure, running several projects at pace as priorities shift.

raw.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

raw.title: Director of Application Engineering
raw.description:
About us:

Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.

We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.

Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. 

Leading the engineering organisation responsible for our agentic research product and customer-facing applications. You’ll set direction, strengthen the management layer and ensure teams deliver reliable products that create measurable customer value.

What you'll own

You'll lead the engineering teams behind our agentic research product and the applications customers use every day, through a group of engineering managers.

You'll be accountable for:

  • Direction and structure: set the direction for application engineering within our engineering strategy; define team structure and the operating model; make the significant resourcing and structural decisions.

  • Delivery: monthly plans that teams actually meet, built with Product on real capacity, with trade-offs made explicit when priorities change and progress visible to everyone; drive roadmaps and cross-functional technical programmes.

  • Customer value: keep your teams focused on outcomes, not output. Understand the problems our customers' scientists are solving, check that what we ship gets used and makes a difference, and change or stop what doesn't.

  • Quality and reliability: own the quality, security and operational health of what your teams ship, from release practice to incident response.

  • People and culture: manage and coach engineering managers, build a strong management layer, own the hiring plan, and be accountable for the culture across your org.

  • AI-first engineering: drive AI-first workflows across all your teams, invest in reusable tooling and enablement, and set standards and ROI targets for how we build with agents, from planning to code review to release.

  • Partnership: work with VPs and Product leadership on what we build, and with Data, DevOps and Security on how it fits together; represent engineering externally in hiring.

Your impact is department-wide: you'll be part of the engineering leadership team, help shape engineering-wide decisions, and step in to lead engineering when needed.

What success looks like

  • Teams plan on real capacity with Product and deliver predictably, in small increments.

  • Every area has a clear owner, and teams are shaped around clear mandates.

  • AI-first engineering is how the whole function works: from planning to automated testing, review and release.

  • Your engineering managers grow, and the teams become a place strong engineers want to join and stay.

  • Teams judge success by the value customers get, not the number of features shipped, and customers notice the difference release after release.

What we're looking for

You'll need

  • 10+ years in software engineering and 4+ years leading engineering managers, ideally in a scale-up environment.

  • A track record of predictable delivery: planning on real capacity, limiting work in progress, and saying no or making trade-offs with Product.

  • A customer-first mindset: you measure your teams by the value they deliver, not the features they ship, and you bring engineers close to the customers they build for.

  • Real experience leading teams that build with AI coding agents (Claude Code or similar), including how review, testing and quality change when agents write most of the code.

  • Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones.

  • Clear, direct communication with engineers, product leaders and executives.

How we'll assess you

  • Leadership: broad engineering leadership across several sub-domains; a strategic thinker who can judge direction for areas you don't personally know in depth.

  • AI fluency: you already embed AI in how your teams work, and you can take it to the next level for a whole function: AI-first workflows across teams, shared tooling, clear standards and measurable return.

Nice to have

  • Experience leading teams that ship LLM, ML or other AI-powered features to production, with enough technical depth to challenge architecture and quality decisions.

  • Life sciences, biomedical data or B2B SaaS for enterprise customers.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems (multi-step agents, tool use, evaluation).

We are on a mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs for ALL humankind, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and fairly consider qualified candidates without regard to race, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, genetics, age, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, domestic / family status, veteran status or any other difference.

raw.description:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

  • Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.

  • Our culture is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

  • All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

  • Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.

  • Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

GTM Strategy & Ops EMEA (London)

We’re excited for our first GTM Strat Ops EMEA to design and build our sales engine. This is a new and unique role. To do that, this person will wear many hats simultaneously including: product manager — roadmapping and designing solutions, operations strategist — working backwards from finance goals to operational milestones, technical architect — making changes to our systems, business partner — getting really deep with your end users (sales), and RevOps pro — building processes fit for scale like transparent ROE.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Strategy & Analysis:

  • Ensure all GTM functions in EMEA are working together to scale the region and are unblocked from all process, systems and operational log jams. For example, you’ll ensure community and sales should be executing well together in region to reach our goals.

  • Partner with EMEA leadership to define and drive regional objectives to success (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and analyze results for the region by conducting insightful analysis that help to drive action

  • Support the regional operating rhythm, including business reviews, forecasting, and pipeline management cadences. Ensure that our global operating priorities are executed thoughtfully locally while balancing regional nuance with global sales methodologies.

  • Act as a partner to the EMEA sales team and the EMEA sales operations lead, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

  • Ensure that the internal GTM Ops and Engineering team is prioritizing and roadmapping automations and applications needed locally, establishing business value from features

  • Extend the global business locally: ensure that sales methodologies and procedures are embedded into the business

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in business strategy, operations, and analysis with at least 4 years in revenue operations at a hypergrowth AI / SaaS company

  • You’ve implemented novel GTM strategies with measurable business impact: reinvented the playbook before from first principles and are excited to do it again

  • Exceptional quantitative modeling skills with experience understanding sales performance

  • Executive (but still grounded) presence: you communicate clearly, challenge assumptions in the room, and are comfortable saying "I don't know yet!”

  • An informed perspective on AI and real examples of how you've put it to work in your workflows or team processes

  • You’re excited to spend time speaking with our customers and community to bring Clay's best practices to market
