raw.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Summary:

Delinea is seeking a talented Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Technical Support team, providing world-class support to our customers.

 

Our ideal candidate is a responsible and motivated self-starter with a desire to learn modern technologies and concepts and solve technical questions.

 

This individual should have significant technical knowledge and understanding of IT, networking, and cyber security concepts, combined with the ability to troubleshoot technical customer issues and maintain a clear, professional, and efficient customer interaction.

This position reports directly to the Technical Support team manager.

 

This role includes participation in a shared on-call rotation, which may require availability outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support production issues and escalations. On-call responsibilities are distributed across the team on a rotating basis.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Provide post-sale technical support to customers and partners

  • Assess and document reported customer issues

  • Formulate and communicate resolution plans

  • Gather necessary information and resources

  • Investigate and reproduce case scenarios

  • Provide clear customer responses and document corrective actions

 

What You'll Need:

  • 1-2 years of proven relevant professional experience as a technical support agent or its equivalent

  • In depth knowledge and experience in at least some of the following:

  • IT and System administration

  • Networking and data transport and encryption

  • Cloud infrastructure, Machine, network and services virtualization

  • Security concepts and methodologies

  • Relational databases and SQL language proficiency and .NET applications are a bonus

 

What Else:

  • Troubleshooting and problem deconstruction

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Ability to work diverse, international, customer and team environments

  • Able to communicate technical concepts at a professional level in multiple languages is a plus.

  • Trustworthy, self-motivated, and reliable

  • Accountability, transparency, and ownership

  • Desire to work in a dynamic and challenging environment

  • Organized and methodological with great attention to detail

  • Prior or current security clearance - a plus

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

About the role

Reporting to our Financial Controller, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Audit experience.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE

Engineering Lead for the Acquisition team. You’ll report to our Head of Engineering. You’ll work closely with the PM to lead the team toward its goals, owning delivery, operational reliability and developer experience. You’ll ship production code and provide technical coaching and leadership to the engineers around you, not line management. You’ll also shape how the team uses AI tools and coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Lead a team building products that directly drive Flock’s growth

  • Own delivery and technical quality for the Acquisition team, working hand in hand with the PM to ship features that directly impact how fleets find and choose Flock.

  • Write high-quality, well-tested TypeScript and own end-to-end delivery to production

Partner with product to drive impact

  • Work closely with the PM, the Engineering Leadership Team and stakeholders to translate business goals into clear technical scope, success metrics and delivery plans.

Grow engineers around you

  • Lead by example through code, design discussions and pairing.

  • Coach and mentor engineers across the team to raise standards and share ownership of technical direction.

Shape how the team works, not just what it builds

  • Drive improvements to developer experience, CI/CD, observability and release practices that make the whole team faster and more confident.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs that balance reliability, performance and cost across AWS services.

  • Decide how the team uses AI, from coding assistants to agent workflows in review and release, keeping engineering judgement where it matters.

Curious how we build the future of fleet insurance? Dive into our Product & Engineering Blog, packed with technical deep-dives, behind-the-scenes stories, and real insights from the team you’d be joining.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

As an Engineering Lead at Flock you’ll own delivery and technical direction for the Acquisition team, co-leading with the PM to ship products that directly drive growth, while raising the bar for the engineers around you.

API-Driven Development

  • Integrate with and contribute to the development of RESTful APIs exposed via API Gateway.

Serverless & Cloud Infrastructure

  • Use your AWS experience (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch) to support and extend the Acquisition team’s services and pipelines.

  • Work with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CDK for provisioning and managing cloud resources.

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

  • Co-own the team’s success with the PM, jointly leading projects from scoping and planning through to delivery and measuring impact.

  • Give engineers the space and ownership to lead projects themselves, asking the right questions to challenge their thinking and help them land on the right solution.

Code Quality & Technical Standards

  • Deliver high-quality, well-tested code and act as a force-multiplier, raising standards through code reviews, pairing and design discussions.

  • Champion practical testing, type-safe APIs and pragmatic patterns that shape long-term technical direction across the team.

  • Set the example on AI-assisted development and coach engineers on where it genuinely speeds the team up and where human judgement needs to stay in the loop.

Working closely with your PM, you’ll bring clarity to complex problems and help define sharply scoped, impactful deliverables. Your success won’t be measured by your own output alone, but by the output, quality and growth of the whole team around you.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • Proven ability to co-lead a team alongside a PM, taking joint ownership of delivery, quality and outcomes, not just your own output.

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability; comfortable shipping high-quality, well-tested TypeScript in production and holding the team to the same standard.

  • Significant experience with AWS and modern serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch) or other cloud platforms.

  • A pragmatic approach to technical decisions, balancing reliability, observability, performance and cost, and bringing engineers along on the reasoning.

  • Track record of raising engineering standards as a force-multiplier, through code reviews, pairing, design discussions and shaping long-term technical direction.

  • Strong communication skills; able to represent the team upwards and translate business goals into clear technical scope and delivery plans.

  • Confident using AI development tools every day, with experience of helping a team adopt them without letting quality slip.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience aligning technical direction beyond your immediate team, working with senior stakeholders and other leads to shape how engineering works at a broader level.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CDK, with a track record of improving operational resilience through observability, runbooks and automated recovery.

raw.title: Production Engineer, Network Engineering
raw.description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

raw.description:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

 

Role Purpose

We're looking for an exceptional Research Engineer with strong computational skills and a track record of applying them to large-scale data science. A background in human genetics is preferred, but if you come from another quantitative field and are excited by the potential of genetics to transform healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll join a team of experts in human genetics, data science and software engineering, building the platform at the heart of our Life Sciences work – (1) helping us derive new insights into human biology and guide drug development towards safer, more effective targets; (2) providing our SaaS customers with innovative analytics. How your time splits across methodology, software engineering and analysis will reflect your own balance of computational and scientific strengths.

This role can be hired at IC2 (Research Engineer) or IC3 (Senior Research Engineer) level, depending on your experience. At IC3, you'll operate with greater autonomy, hold a broader technical scope, bring deeper subject-matter expertise, and lead projects that require integrated updates across multiple tools, working with cross-disciplinary teams to deliver value.

A Day in the Life

At the heart of this role is the opportunity to collaborate with domain experts at the cutting edge of statistical genetics and rapidly translate their innovations into a mature, integrated data & analytics engine for commercial use at scale.

  • Help expand and maintain our in-house Life Sciences tools and pipelines, planning your own work and contributing code to a shared codebase alongside Research Engineering team members, Software Engineers and Data Scientists.

  • Implement algorithms developed within our Life Sciences teams to a high standard of robustness, testing and performance.

  • Run high-quality analyses of large-scale biological datasets using existing or bespoke tools, and share your findings with scientists and other stakeholders.

  • Contribute to internal and external presentations and publications arising from our work.

  • Keep your knowledge current on innovation and good practice in genomics, data science and scientific computing.

  • At Senior (IC3) level, you'll also lead projects that need integrated updates across multiple tools, coordinating with cross-disciplinary teams to deliver value.

Who You Are

Essential

  • A strong quantitative background in a scientific field, with the ability to explain complex ideas to specialists and non-specialists alike.

  • Skilled at writing high-quality Python code using modern software development practices.

  • Confident analysing and learning from large-scale datasets in a scientific context.

  • Experienced running tools and workflows in a scalable system, for example Linux based HPC environments or on cloud systems.

  • Comfortable using LLM programming assistants appropriately within a research software environment.

It'd be great if you also have

  • Experience working on a collaborative codebase using version control and CI/CD.

  • Familiarity with common bioinformatics and genomics tools and file formats.

  • Experience designing and running large-scale workflows, e.g. WDL, CWL.

  • Experience working in remote, cloud-based environments, e.g. AWS.

  • Experience creating and working with containers, e.g. Docker, Singularity.

  • Additional programming languages, particularly R or C++.

  • A PhD or postgraduate degree in a scientific field, ideally genomics, bioinformatics or computational biology, with familiarity in statistics and machine learning.

  • Prior experience working in a team, ideally in an industry setting.

     

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Salary: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid Working (e.g., From our London, Oxford Office)

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

If this opportunity excites you, apply now!

Associate Project Manager
raw.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.

  • Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.

  • Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.

  • Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.

  • Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.

  • Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.

  • Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.

  • Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.

  • You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.

  • You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Manager Interview - 60 minutes

  • Skills presentation - 60 minutes

  • Values Interview - 60 minutes

  • Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own end-to-end model delivery on hx, from scoping and build through to testing, iteration, and customer delivery.

  • Build and maintain production-grade Python models, applying modern engineering and modelling practices.

  • Work directly with customer actuarial teams and internal stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous modelling and coding problems.

  • Raise quality across the team through code review, testing, and contributions to best-practice model development guidance.

  • Support and mentor junior model developers through pairing, feedback, and day-to-day delivery support.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve our model development standards, tooling, and ways of working.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments.

  • Applied predictive modelling or advanced analytics in real-world settings (insurance or reinsurance exposure is a bonus, not a requirement).

  • Taken ownership of ambiguous problems, creating structure and driving them through to high-quality outcomes.

  • Worked directly with non-technical stakeholders or customers, translating requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Operated effectively in a high-trust, high-accountability environment, proactively driving your own development and learning.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

 

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 
 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

raw.title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

raw.description:
Product Lead, Security & Identity

 

Location: Bristol or London (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Lead
Team:
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Director - Platform & Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

  • You will own the product roadmap for Security & Identity, working with the Head of Security to shape and deliver it by setting outcomes, prioritising across the four teams and reporting progress to leadership.

  • You will be the voice of the client and the engineering community in security decisions, and the person who turns security from a set of controls into a product people want to use.
    Work closely with the Head of Security to shape and deliver our Security & Identity strategy for Kaluza.

  • Ensure security enables velocity and client value while protecting data: shifting security left delivery cycle.

  • Embed a secure-by-default ethos across the organisation, finding ways to make being secure the easiest option.

  • Work closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering teams and directly with clients to understand their identity needs and integrate their systems with ours.

  • Lead the cyber product response to AI: embed the responsible use of AI across our Security and identity capability, including non-human identity, agent authorisation and guardrails for AI tooling.

  • Embed requirements from across our compliance obligations including ISO, client, regulatory, standards, policy into our roadmap, helping ensure we maintain our compliance.

  • Contribute to the client-facing security story: security assurance for RFPs and client reviews, and reporting on security posture to clients and the board.

  • Contribute to the tooling and vendor strategy for security and identity (identity provider, authorisation, detection and response tooling), making the investment case into the technology budget.

  • Partner with Platform Foundations so that security-by-design and data residency requirements are built into the platform, not bolted on.

  • Develop and foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence and continuous improvement across Security & Identity


What you’ll bring

  • Deep experience in either cyber security or identity and access management.

  • Strong product craft: a proven ability to set outcomes and deliver against them.

  • Demonstrable experience working with counterparts in engineering and security to develop and execute a multi-year strategy and roadmap.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tooling and ways of working to deliver outcomes, and a strong builder mentality.

  • Customer obsessed but outcome focused: experience finding novel solutions to client problems rather than defaulting to process.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills: comfortable with senior leadership, and experienced in presenting strategy, outcomes, risk and investment cases to get buy-in and support.


Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience working across multiple global regions, with an understanding of implementing complex regulatory frameworks globally.

  • Experience in regulated or data-sovereignty-sensitive markets (energy, utilities, financial services), including EU data residency.

  • Experience with security or identity for a B2B SaaS platform that serves external clients, including federation with client identity providers.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

raw.description:
Role: QA Automation Lead

Location: London, Bristol

Level: C3

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Senior QA Manager

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.

The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

 

  • Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

  • Provide the tooling for creating test data, building test automation and reporting test results.

  • Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

  • Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

  • Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out.

  • Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

  • Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.


What you’ll bring

  • Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

  • Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

  • Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

  • A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

  • Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to AI agent testing.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate with multiple stakeholders towards a common goal.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented mindset, with the willingness to speak up, highlight areas for improvement and suggest solutions.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, such as LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks or MCP-based tooling.

  • Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, models or agents, covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct?) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI’s behaviour acceptable?).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Knowledgade of Jira and test management tools such as XRay.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

raw.title: Head of Risk
raw.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

 
 

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

 
 

Background and Experience

Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts).

Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes.

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

  • The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role.

Our recruitment philosophy


We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary and global benefit package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to semi-flexible working hours=

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process.

As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Data Analyst (Vessel Particulars)
raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As a Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the accuracy, completeness and reliability of Kpler’s vessel particulars datasets. Your work will underpin our core products and commercial decisions by ensuring that vessel-level data is accurate, consistent and comprehensive.

Combining hands-on data curation with independent analysis, you will research and validate information from multiple sources, identify data gaps and anomalies, and develop processes to improve data quality. You will take ownership of specific vessel data domains while helping automate recurring tasks and strengthen the reliability of our data pipelines.

Working closely with the Vessel Data Manager, Market Analysts, Product and Engineering teams, you will contribute to continuous improvements in our vessel data capabilities and ensure that our datasets meet the needs of internal teams and customers.




Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end quality of assigned vessel particulars datasets, including specifications, ownership, classification and technical attributes.
  • Research and validate vessel data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, consistency and completeness.
  • Analyse datasets to identify data gaps and anomalies, developing and running validation checks to improve data quality and coverage.
  • Create and maintain SQL- and Python-based workflows to automate recurring data collection, cleansing and enrichment tasks.
  • Develop dashboards and reports to monitor vessel data quality, providing Market Analysts with relevant vessel-level insights.
  • Support the integration of new vessel data sources, including scoping, testing and validating incoming data feeds.
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues raised by internal teams or customers, identifying root causes and implementing fixes.
  • Document data logic, business rules and definitions to ensure consistency and adherence to vessel particulars data standards.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to translate data quality findings into platform and pipeline improvements.
  • Work proactively with the Vessel Data Manager, taking ownership of issues independently, communicating clearly and recommending solutions.

    • Skills and Experience
  • 2–4 years of experience in a data analyst, data quality or data operations role.
  • Experience working with SQL for data querying, cleansing and analysis.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of vessel data and maritime shipping concepts.
  • Experience working with large, real-world datasets, particularly vessel particulars.
  • Experience in the maritime industry.
  • Strong analytical skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience with data validation, monitoring and quality-improvement techniques.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently and prioritise effectively.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Nice to have
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools and dashboarding.
  • Practical experience with ETL processes and/or web scraping for data collection.
  • Experience using Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience working with APIs for data ingestion and validation.
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with maritime data sources.
    • We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

    We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
     
    Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information.

Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information.

Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.description:
Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Team, taking a leading role in building the complex, scalable systems that power our data strategy. You will lead architectural discussions, own the design of business-critical data solutions and deliver high-quality systems that bring millions of fans closer to the sports they love. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation.

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead the design and delivery of robust data pipelines using GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage. This includes integrating data from various sources, ensuring data quality and enabling real-time processing capabilities.
  • Own the design of data models and databases that support business analytics and intelligence, using dimensional data-modelling principles. Select and use GCP database technologies such as Bigtable, Spanner or Firestore to optimise performance and scalability.
  • Lead the automation of data workflows and optimisation of data storage and processing costs within GCP. Use tools such as Cloud Composer for orchestration and establish best practices in performance tuning.
  • Ensure data security by implementing GCP security practices. Manage access controls, comply with data-governance policies and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Work closely with data engineers, business analysts and IT teams to define data requirements and deliver comprehensive data solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members.
  • Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products.
  • Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented.
  • Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
  • Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems.
  • Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms.
  • Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately.
  • Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques.
  • Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing.
  • Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker.
  • Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.
  • A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.
  • A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

raw.title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across the UK and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English; French, German, Dutch, or a Nordic language is a plus

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
