raw.title: Financial Controller (Process & Control)
raw.description:
What We’re All About.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

What you’ll bring.

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence

  • Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.

  • Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap aligned to business objectives, operational efficiency, governance requirements and future compliance needs, including SOX readiness.

  • Analyse and redesign finance processes to improve productivity, control effectiveness and user experience.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies, developing practical and prioritised remediation plans.

  • Establish robust data governance, validation and reporting frameworks to improve the quality, consistency and reliability of financial information.

  • Map and optimise end-to-end transaction flows across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Support the creation of scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide meaningful operational and financial insight.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Lead finance systems and automation projects from initial requirements through to implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.

  • Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate, select and implement solutions that support future-state finance operations.

  • Drive automation opportunities across close processes, journal management, reconciliations, variance analysis and reporting.

  • Ensure data integrity, auditability and control considerations are embedded within all system and process changes.

  • Establish governance standards for financial data, system ownership and ongoing process maintenance.

Programme Delivery & Change Management

  • Apply disciplined project and programme management practices including planning, risk management, benefits tracking, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.

  • Define success measures and ensure transformation benefits are tracked, validated and sustained over time.

  • Build engagement and buy-in across the finance organisation by clearly communicating objectives, priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Support teams through process, technology and organisational change, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working.

  • Translate complex finance, operational and technology challenges into clear and actionable implementation plans.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Legal, Operations and commercial functions to align transformation priorities with wider business objectives.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on finance process, controls, systems and operating model design.

  • Work alongside finance teams to resolve complex operational challenges, improve processes and implement best practices.

  • Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on programme progress, risks, benefits realisation and key transformation milestones.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the finance function.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential.

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ICAS, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience operating at Head of Finance / Financial Controller level, with broad oversight of the full accounting cycle (AP through to management accounts).

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-GAAP statutory accounting across multiple entities/jurisdictions.

  • Deep understanding of controllership processes: financial close cycles, account reconciliation, consolidation, intercompany accounting, journal entry management, and statutory reporting.

  • Track record of successfully leading financial systems/process implementation projects (e.g. ERP implementation, close process redesign, close automation tooling).

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement future-state close operating models covering process, automation, controls, data, and people.

  • Strong project management skills and experience, ideally with formal methodology exposure (e.g. Agile, Prince2, or similar).

  • Experience leading teams through significant change, with a genuine ability to bring people along on the journey.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented while also operating strategically.

Desirable.

  • Hands-on implementation or advisory experience with one or more close automation or EPM platforms (e.g. FloQast, BlackLine, OneStream, Prophix, or comparable).

  • Experience in a fast-growing, multi-entity, international business (SaaS/technology sector a plus).

  • Experience with modern finance/ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and reporting/automation tools.

  • Familiarity with the intersection between close quality, internal controls, and external audit.

  • Prior experience partnering with Legal, HR, and commercial teams on cross-functional finance matters.

  • PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification, or a Lean Six Sigma qualification.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. raw.title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
raw.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do
  • Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
  • Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
  • Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
  • Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
  • Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
  • You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
  • You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
  • You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
  • You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
  • You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
  • You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
  • You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
  • You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
  • You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

raw.title: Senior Applied Research Scientist - Personalization
raw.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Within Personalization, the Speak Team owns the development of Spotify's state-of-the-art speech models, contributing to speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech-to-speech models. We craft voice models that match human-level emotional expressiveness, so we can deeply engage our listeners and support creators at scale. Our groundbreaking work on speech synthesis relies on state-of-the-art deep learning methods and evaluation techniques, highly efficient data processing and model serving, and capturing audio of outstanding quality from our voice talent pool.

We're looking for a senior applied research scientist with experience in developing novel ML techniques and architectures and with a strong interest in working across a full production pipeline to produce state-of-the-art generative conversational speech-to-speech models. You'll collaborate with our engineering teams to help develop our production pipelines, explore new ideas and methods to improve quality, understanding and realism, as well as push the frontiers of what is possible with our speech technology.

What You'll Do
  • Develop and experiment with new methods for speech synthesis and speech recognition, along with end-to-end approaches, building on the latest research and ideas.
  • Work towards the expansion of our speech use-cases targeting different markets and products.
  • Be part of a highly motivated research team dedicated to building and creating models at scale to power the Spotify platform.
  • Champion best practices for research and development, sharing your knowledge and experience with other researchers within Speak.
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data teams on ideas requiring new infrastructure or new high-quality data, as well as to help improve our speech recognition and speech synthesis pipelines, and help turn proven ideas into scalable products.

    • Who You Are
  • You have a strong background in ML (PhD degree on top of professional experience), and experience in working with any of the following: transformers, GANs, diffusion models, flow matching, VAEs, audio codecs.
  • You have experience in developing generative models for speech synthesis, speech recognition, audio/music, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • You have strong experience with Python, particularly PyTorch.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical ideas with clarity to technical and non-technical people alike.
  • You have experience in an academic or professional setting conducting high-quality research.

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Information Technology
raw.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
 
The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We are the team behind the technology that approximately 8,000 Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning endpoint and device management, identity and access, networking and connectivity, IT service management and support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity and collaboration platforms, work management tooling, and the AI tools changing how everyone at Spotify works. Across 9 teams, we touch almost every part of how Spotify functions as a company.
 
We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead a group of Engineering Managers and approximately 50 engineers and technicians across the studio. You’ll set engineering strategy, strengthen the technical practices that help our teams operate at their best, and partner closely with product and studio leadership to balance engineering investment with business priorities.

What You'll Do
  • Lead and develop Engineering Managers across multiple teams, supporting their growth while creating clarity around outcomes and engineering excellence.
  • Set and communicate engineering strategy across the studio, ensuring teams have clear technical direction aligned with IT’s mandate and Spotify’s business needs.
  • Strengthen technical judgment across the Engineering Manager group, challenging processes that no longer add value and creating more space for architecture, quality, and team capability.
  • Identify patterns and opportunities across teams and drive improvements in engineering practice, operational health, reliability, and ways of working.
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices across the studio, helping teams share knowledge and consistently improve how we build and operate technology.
  • Champion reliability, security, compliance, and privacy as fundamental parts of engineering decision-making.
  • Shape how AI is used across the company, both through the tools our squads build and how our engineers work day to day.
  • Partner with studio and alliance leadership, procurement, legal, engineering counterparts, and teams across Spotify to make thoughtful technical investments and solve meaningful business problems.

    • Who You Are

The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications.

  • Improve how sessions are established, maintained, and ended, balancing reliable access with account protection, privacy, and user control.
  • Shape device connection, session transfer, and partner authorization experiences, including clear consent when an app requests access or additional capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering to make session and access capabilities reusable and easier to adopt through APIs, client components, documentation, and clear integration guidance.

raw.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

raw.title: SRE - Security & Compliance
raw.description:
What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

We’re looking for a mission-driven Site Reliability Engineer to join the Apps & Platform team in Engineering. You'll bring security and compliance into how we build and run our AWS platform every day, not just at audit time, and you'll do it hands-on in the infrastructure.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Running the technical side of our ISO 27001 programme. You'll keep our controls passing in Drata, collect evidence from AWS, GitHub and our identity tools, and fix what fails yourself.

  • Hardening and running our AWS estate with the platform team: IAM and SSO, networking and firewalling, encryption, secrets, backups and disaster recovery, all in Terraform.

  • Owning vulnerability management across engineering. You'll triage findings from Aikido and our annual penetration test, and work with product teams to get them fixed.

  • Making our systems observable and our incident response sharp: alerting in Datadog and Sentry, on-call, postmortems, and runbooks/skills people actually use.

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has run production infrastructure on AWS and writes Terraform comfortably

  • Has hands-on experience with a security framework such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2: you've owned controls and produced the evidence

  • Has sound security instincts and knows when a risk is worth accepting

  • Has been on call, worked real incidents, and made things better afterwards

  • Weighs cost and complexity, and picks the simplest thing that works at our scale

  • Meets an unfamiliar problem with "I'll find out", whether it's a CIDR clash, a failing control or a vendor console you've never opened

  • Ideally knows their way around Kubernetes (EKS), Linux and network debugging, identity and device management (e.g. JumpCloud), and AI coding agents in infrastructure work

  • Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Benefits 💰

  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup

  • Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

  • Unlimited annual leave - we hold Sylverans to account based on outcome rather than inputs

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Local bar tab at the end of the month

  • Weekly drinks in the office

  • Catered lunch once a month in office

  • Monthly Deliveroo/equivalent allowance once a month

Location 🌍

London, UK (hybrid). We work flexibly whilst encouraging people to come in regularly to our great office in Old St

Our Values 🙌

  • Own it: We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

  • Stay curious: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

  • Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

  • Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

  • Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to protect society from fraud and money laundering. We’ve already protected over 3 million people through life’s big transactions.

Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering.

Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud.

Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking.

Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over $33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel.

 

About the role:

You'll join Thirdfort at an exciting moment for Tenant Referencing. We're rebuilding the product from the ground up, moving it off a legacy platform onto Thirdfort's strategic engineering platform (Go, Temporal-based workflows, cloud-native). You'll be one of the first permanent engineers on a newly-formed squad, with real scope to shape how tenant referencing gets architected and make technical calls on a live migration. It matters beyond the tech, too. Tenant referencing is where our fraud-prevention mission meets something that matters to people directly: renting a home.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, is comfortable without a fully mature spec, and is pragmatic about tooling, including using AI where it helps them move faster.

For this role, we would love this person to be able to join us in our London office two times a week as being together as a team is valuable for us but ultimately, we trust our team to decide what works best for them.


You will achieve your mission as our Senior Software Engineer by:
  • Helping lead the rebuild of our tenant referencing product, migrating it from our legacy platform onto Thirdfort's strategic engineering platform (Go, Temporal-based workflows), working across both systems during the transition
  • Designing and building backend services and APIs that power tenant referencing checks, and contributing to our frontend (React/TypeScript) and mobile platforms when needed
  • Making independent architecture and delivery decisions on a fast-moving, still-forming squad, working closely with our Product & Tech Lead
  • Upholding engineering quality through testing, observability, and code review, as we build permanent engineering ownership into the team
  • Partnering closely with Ops and Support to understand real tenant referencing workflows and translating that understanding into good technical decisions
  • Using modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, to build new check types and features quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Mentoring and uplifting engineering practices across the squad as it grows

    • You may be right for this role if you:

    Hard requirements:

  • Have strong backend service experience in a modern programming language, with the ability to ramp up quickly in Go
  • Have experience designing, building, and integrating APIs
  • Have experience working in cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP)
  • Have taken ownership of ambiguous technical problems and seen them through with minimal oversight

    • Nice to haves:

  • Have experience with workflow orchestration or event-driven systems (e.g. Temporal)
  • Are comfortable using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as part of your everyday workflow
  • Have experience working across a legacy-to-modern platform migration
  • Have some experience with React/TypeScript and/or mobile development

    • “Studies show that women and other less represented groups are less likely to apply for roles unless they meet every requirement. We believe in building a diverse team, valuing different skills and experiences and so if you don’t think you have all the requirements listed here but feel this could be a role and environment you’d thrive in, we would still love for you to apply."


    Our Benefits:

    We've created our benefits package to reflect Thirdfort's mission and values. Everything we do is designed to build on trust, and we extend this promise to our team by investing in their physical, mental, and financial security to support them through life's big moments. Ultimately, our benefits exist to empower our people, ensuring everyone feels deeply supported, trusted, and equipped to do their best work.

     

    When you join Thirdfort, you'll get immediate access to our employee benefits package that aims to support you across these areas:

  • Compensation: up to £100,000 base salary
  • Location - London Office - twice per week
  • Share options for all UK employees
  • Annual leave allowance of 26 days, increasing to 30 with tenure and the option to buy additional days
  • Uncapped personal development budget
  • Flexible working hours
  • Private healthcare (AXA)
  • Enhanced parental and sick leave


    • We're committed to building an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture where everyone has a chance to make a difference. We're purposefully building a team of problem-solvers that reflect our values, which is why we hire from all backgrounds. If you're a curious, kind individual who takes ownership, you'll be a great Thirdforter.

     

    If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please let your dedicated Talent Partner know and we'll do our best to accommodate.

raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Solution Architect for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site 

The Role

Are you a visionary technical leader who thrives on bringing clarity to complex engineering challenges?

In this influential role, you’ll act as the bridge where mobile engineering, product strategy, security, and delivery converge. Partnering with high-profile clients, you will shape resilient, secure, and user-friendly digital mobile experiences that millions rely on daily. You will work ahead of delivery teams to resolve architectural ambiguity, steer platform evolution, and lead with empathy, collaboration, and purpose.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Strategic Architecture & Vision: Shape and lead end-to-end mobile architecture across iOS, Android, APIs, and cloud services, aligning technical roadmaps with long-term business goals.

  • Platform Governance & Innovation: Define organisation-wide security, resilience, and performance standards while leading proof-of-concepts for emerging technologies.

  • Executive & Stakeholder Influence: Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders and client steering boards, effectively translating complex technical strategies into clear, impactful choices.

  • Engineering & Practice Leadership: Drive practice-wide capability growth, build playbooks, and foster an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture by mentoring and empowering teams across multiple squads.

  • Secure & Resilient Design: Champion "secure by design" principles, threat modeling, and robust platform controls to protect customers and maintain platform integrity at scale.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring

  • Architectural Mastery: Strong expertise designing end-to-end mobile platform solutions, mobile SDKs, shared libraries, and modularised codebases across iOS and Android.

  • Strategic & Inclusive Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders, resolve organisational challenges, and guide cross-functional teams with clarity and empathy.

  • Security & Resilience Focus: Deep appreciation for secure design principles, threat modeling, authentication, tamper detection, and operational reliability in enterprise environments.

  • Modern Engineering Mindset: Experience in agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Collaborative Coaching: Passion for nurturing talent, designing upskilling initiatives, building communities of practice, and establishing reusable organisational accelerators.

  • Domain Exposure (Desirable): Experience within regulated financial services, high-control enterprise environments, or evaluating vendor SDKs and cloud-native services

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one!

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

raw.description:
Slingshot AI

Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.

We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.

We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.

The role

This role is for someone who wants to learn fast, move fast and make an impact early in their career. Slingshot is a small team of senior specialists. Many of us were CTOs, CEOs or founders before we joined, and each person owns an area that a larger company would give to a whole team.

You will join our strategy and ops team and work closely with our Chief of Staff. Your work will be solving operational problems across teams, wherever the business needs help most. One day that might be reaching out to therapists we want to recruit as experts. The next it might be building an automated system to manage our vendor spend. Anything and everything the business needs to succeed is in scope.

Few roles let you see how a whole company runs. You will be close to the decisions on key areas across the business, learn how experienced operators make them, and own pieces of that work yourself from your first weeks.

Our team builds with AI and automation every day. You will learn from them how to use these tools to get more done, for yourself and for the people you support.

What you will do

  • Give leverage to a senior team. Work with the Chief of Staff and alongside former CTOs, CEOs and founders on the problems that land on their desks each day. You take a loose ask, work out what is needed and get it done.

  • Act quickly to solve ambiguous problems. Take on a problem area in the business, find out what is going wrong, lay out the options and run the fix.

  • Own how we interact with external resources. One specific area we are looking for you to own is how we source and manage contractors, agencies, vendors, and other external resources at our disposal.

  • Upskill yourself and your systems over time. Learn from our experts in AI and automation to stay on the forefront of how these tools can take work off of your plate.

About you

  • You are early in your career and have already done a lot. You have up to three years of experience at an early-stage startup, a top consulting firm or a top investment bank, and you have a consistent track record of going above and beyond.

  • You can “drink from the firehose”. You have a track record of learning fast in high-intensity environments.

  • You ask the right questions, then move. Given a messy problem, you find out what you need to know and leave the rest.

  • You have a bias to action. You will send the emails yourself today if that solves the problem, and you can tell when it is worth building something or buying it in instead.

  • You use AI to give yourself leverage. You explore new ways to use AI to make your work faster and better regularly and are excited to learn from experts on this.

  • You care about the mission. You want to help make mental health support accessible to more people.

  • You are based in London and want to work from our London office in-person.

What we offer

  • A chance to learn from a world-class team at a fast paced startup that is at the frontier of its field

  • A chance to join a passionate tight knit team working on something to change the world

  • Competitive compensation (top of personal market) and meaningful equity

  • Travel between our NYC and London offices

  • Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office plus a generous learning budget

  • We cover your personal therapy

raw.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner

Help take Solve Intelligence 3x in a single year. We’re looking for a recruiter with strong engineering hiring experience who wants to recruit across the business and help build our talent function.

🏗️ About the role

You’ll be an early hire in our talent team, owning searches from first outreach through to signed offer. Engineering recruitment will be a core part of your remit, alongside GTM, legal, operations and other functions as the business grows. You’ll need to enjoy that breadth and get to grips with unfamiliar roles quickly.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Running multiple searches across engineering, AI research, GTM, legal and operations, from understanding the requirements to closing the offer.

  • Building pipelines through direct sourcing, using targeted outreach and newer AI sourcing tools to find candidates beyond inbound applications and agencies.

  • Deciding which searches need your attention most, understanding the business priorities behind them, and flagging risks early.

  • Working with hiring managers to define what each role requires and design assessments that help us make hiring decisions. You’ll need enough technical understanding to assess engineering candidates and discuss your judgement with the team.

  • Improving hiring quality and offer acceptance by understanding candidates’ motivations early and closing people with competing offers.

  • Keeping candidates informed throughout the process, with thoughtful outreach, timely updates and honest communication.

  • Helping build the talent function: keeping Ashby accurate, improving workflows and contributing to projects beyond your own searches.

🚀 Who you are

You’ve hired frontend, backend, full-stack and AI engineers, and you understand the differences between those searches. You can read a technical CV critically and hold a substantive first conversation with an engineer.

Your recent experience is either in-house at an early-stage startup or at a recruitment firm working with technical companies that set a high hiring bar. You’re comfortable working with limited support and deciding what needs your attention without waiting for direction.

You care about how recruitment is run. That shows in the outreach you send and the assessment notes hiring managers use to make decisions. You keep Ashby up to date, and candidates know where they stand.

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves

  • Direct experience hiring frontend, backend, full-stack and AI engineers.

  • Recent success in an in-house talent role at an early-stage startup, ideally VC-backed, with minimal support; or at a recruitment firm working with technical companies with a high hiring bar.

  • Experience using Ashby, ideally including improving how it is configured or used.

  • Hands-on sourcing experience and the ability to build a pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluency with newer AI sourcing tools, beyond LinkedIn Recruiter.

  • Strong written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should be good enough to share as examples.

  • Demonstrated ability to close candidates with competing offers.

  • The ability to pick up new roles, understand requirements quickly and build processes from scratch.

Nice to haves

  • An agency or search firm background earlier in your career.

  • Experience building AI-powered recruiting workflows.

  • Experience hiring across multiple countries.

🎁 What we offer

  • £70,000 – £110,000 base salary depending on experience

  • Significant equity; we want you to take real ownership in Solve Intelligence

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • Opportunity to help build the talent function of a generational AI company

  • Private medical insurance

  • Free meals

🚀 About Solve Intelligence

Solve Intelligence is the fastest-growing startup transforming the IP landscape. Solve's AI platform manages everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing.

Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; selling to 700+ global IP teams across 6 continents (DLA Piper, tech giants, boutiques, etc); 8 figures of ARR — all just ~2 years since we started.

Backing: $55M backing from YC, 20VC, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and the founders of top companies like Stripe, Perplexity, Tinder, Deel, Hugging Face, and Canva.

Impact: 50–90% efficiency and quality improvements.

See our latest Series B announcement.

We're on a high-growth trajectory, and we're looking for people who want to join us on the journey to building a generational AI company.

Come join the rocket ship 🚀

👥 Meet the founders

Sanj (Chief Research Officer and Co-Founder): Sanj did his MSci in Physics at the University of Cambridge and his PhD in AI at the Gatsby Unit, UCL. He won awards at top AI conferences, worked on the R&D team at Huawei, and received widespread attention for his contributions to open-source LLM projects on GitHub. He joined Magic Carpet AI as employee #4, where he developed AI strategies for trading, before the company was acquired.

Chris (Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder): Chris did his undergrad at Imperial College London, his masters at the University of Cambridge, and his PhD in machine learning at UCL, during which he published 10+ papers and won awards at top AI conferences and journals. Prior to founding Solve, Chris worked at The Alan Turing Institute, InstaDeep, and Dyson.

Angus (Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder): Angus holds an MEng in Computer Science. He led trade platform development at Coremont after roles at GCHQ and Qualcomm.

raw.description:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of Abnormal AI and Demisto.

Artemis's founders have built and scaled security products used by tens of thousands of customers. Shachar Hirshberg (CEO) led Amazon GuardDuty, the world's largest cloud detection product, was an early employee at Demisto, the company that invented the SOAR category, was an engineering leader at Palo Alto Networks, and holds an MBA from Harvard. Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

Our team of software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers comes from Google, Meta, AWS, Wiz, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Abnormal AI, Perplexity, Bridgewater, Mercor, CERN, and more.

We're growing fast and looking for builders who want to help us serve our rapidly expanding customer base.

The Role

As our first EMEA Channel Sales Manager, you'll own building Artemis's indirect go-to-market motion in the UK and Europe. You'll identify, recruit, and enable strategic partners (Distributors Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) to sell Artemis into new and existing customer base. You'll develop partner programs, provide enablement and support, manage partner relationships, and ensure partners are generating pipeline and closing deals.

This role is critical to scaling beyond direct sales. You'll have autonomy to shape our channel strategy, build partner relationships from scratch, and drive significant revenue through indirect channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit strategic channel partners (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) across the UK and Europe

  • Develop and manage partnership agreements, pricing structures, and incentive programs

  • Onboard new partners and provide initial enablement (product training, positioning, sales tools, technical certification)

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Brand & Creative at Checkout.com
We’re determined to build the best FinTech brand in the world. To do this, we’ve built a Brand & Creative team that is a collaborative group of problem-solvers who partner with people across the business on a wide range of activities. From brand identity, product marketing, and performance campaigns to physical brand environments, responsive web experiences, and bespoke pitches. We’ve built retro games, out-of-home campaigns across Europe and the US, created immersive event experiences, and TV ads that introduce the invisible engine powering payments for the world’s biggest brands. And we’re just getting started.

About the Brand & Creative team
We’re a diverse team of creative thinkers with a strong culture of experimentation and collaboration at its heart. And we love the work we do. Our Creative Operations team helps make sure we’re on the right work at the right time. We partner closely and cross-functionally with Product Design, and hold regular Design Town Halls where we align and cross-pollinate to cultivate our shared vision for design at Checkout. We work closely with partner agencies to realize our vision. We champion our brand attributes, design principles, systems, and standards that support us in creating world-class work with our colleagues and partners. We work alongside sharp Marketeers who help drive our brand awareness across the world, and are the ultimate guardians of the Checkout.com brand.

What does a Brand Manager do at Checkout.com?

Brand Managers at Checkout own our biggest brand moments – from global advertising campaigns and our flagship Peak Season campaign, to the brand-focused initiatives that define how the world sees us. You’ll also be the connective tissue between Checkout.com and our audiences. Working across B2B and B2C campaigns, you’ll lead on everything from goal-setting through to launch and measurement, orchestrating the many moving parts that bring an idea to life across markets and channels. You’ll set clear objectives, plan distribution, coordinate with channel owners, and partner closely with our creatives to make sure every campaign lands with impact. Brand Managers are highly organised, exceptional communicators, and comfortable holding the whole picture – the timeline, the stakeholders, the budget, and the creative ambition – all at once.

What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience planning and delivering integrated brand campaigns end to end, ideally with a mix of B2B and B2C, working alongside creatives, copywriters, media and channel owners to bring big ideas to life.

  • Confidence setting clear campaign goals and KPIs, measuring performance against them, and using the results to sharpen the next moment.

  • Organisational excellence – you can juggle multiple work-streams, timelines, stakeholders and budgets at once without dropping a detail.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams, brief creatives clearly, and keep everyone moving in the same direction

  • Experience planning distribution and coordinating across channels – from out-of-home and paid media to owned and partner channels – to maximise reach and efficiency

  • You think holistically about the campaign – the audience, the message, the channel mix, and the moment it lands in.

  • You’re comfortable interfacing with partner brands and merchants, gaining their buy-in and supporting co-marketing activities that benefit everyone involved.

  • A close collaborator with creative teams, and a guardian of our brand, with a great understanding of how we show up across channels and communications

  • You are skilled in articulating your work, the process, and decisions to cross-functional stakeholders and you’re proactive in getting constructive feedback to help you produce your best work

  • A drive to deliver exceptional work and always iterate for better solution

About you:

  • You care deeply about your work, and strive to deliver the best quality output possible. You welcome constructive criticism

  • You're not an island. You can show and tell us how you've helped the people around you get better, or brought in others’ support from inside or outside the team to get something done

  • You think in systems. You can anticipate the ripple effects small and large changes will have on the brand experience

  • You highly prize being accountable. You take ownership for every action, share faults and failures, strive for better, and build trust

  • You're self motivated and can work independently

  • You love learning. You might not have experience for everything this role requires, but you're excited to grow and learn – sometimes 'wearing many hats' in a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Job Description

Checkout.com is looking for a Senior Manager, Content to lead our Content team, content strategy, and set the editorial direction for everything we publish aligned with our expanding mission, new product segments, and greater global reach.

This is a people management plus hands-on role with real scope. You will own the content roadmap, lead our highest-profile reports and content workstreams, and manage the agencies and budgets that support them. You will also stay close to the craft, personally writing and shaping a wide range of content pieces. You will manage three content specialists, and you will work side by side with senior stakeholders across Marketing and Commercial to make sure our content earns its place in the market.

Why this role exists

Every piece of Checkout.com content should do a job and this role exists to make sure it does.

You will make sure our content:

Drives our commercial objectives, working with teams to ensure there is a clear line from every piece to pipeline, revenue and customer growth

Prepares the ground for our new narrative, so that what we say tomorrow feels earned by what we publish today

Is highly impactful, with a clear point of view and a high bar for quality

Moves our customers, speaking to what they care about in language that changes minds and behaviour

Makes us irresistible in the market, so that Checkout.com is the brand merchants want to work with

Creates genuine thought leadership that shapes how the industry thinks about payments

How you'll make an impact

Editorial direction and content strategy

Set the editorial direction for Checkout.com's content, defining what we stand for, what we say and what good looks like across every format and channel

Translate our evolving narrative and commercial priorities into a clear content strategy, and bring the team and stakeholders along with it

Build and own the content roadmap, making deliberate calls on what to prioritise, what to stop and where to invest

Hold the quality bar for the team's output, making sure every piece is accurate, insight-led and distinctively Checkout.com

Develop and deliver content strategy for new audiences and segments, including SMB and consumer

High-profile reports and content Work-Streams

Lead our flagship reports and highest-profile content work-streams from idea and brief through research, writing, launch and distribution

Personally write or shape our most important content, including large reports, thought leadership, executive-facing pieces and event talk tracks

Make sure our biggest content moments are data-led, evidence-backed and built to be picked up by customers, press and analysts

Define the right measures of success for each workstream, including commercial contribution, audience engagement and share of voice, and use results to decide what to scale, change or stop

Events Content

Drive the content for our high-impact owned and industry events, such as Thrive, SXSW London and Money20/20, so that the story on stage, in the room and after the event is consistent and compelling

Partner with the Experiential team from the start of each event, shaping themes, speaker narratives and content that carries through into wider campaigns and commercial follow-up

Stakeholders and roadmap

Work closely with senior stakeholders across Marketing and Commercial, including Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, Brand, Communications and Sales, to map the content roadmap against business priorities

Act as the content expert in planning forums, communicating recommendations clearly, resolving competing priorities and holding the line on quality and focus when demand outstrips capacity

Ground decisions in customer insight, commercial data and stakeholder feedback

Agencies and budget

Manage the content budget and relevant agency partners, including briefing, performance management and quality control

Shape investment cases and recommend where to spend based on expected value and evidence of returns

Drive agencies to clear KPIs tied to our commercial and marketing objectives

Lead and develop the team

Manage and develop the existing Content team through clear goals, regular coaching, honest feedback and meaningful ownership

Manage team workload and priorities, balancing demand across the business so the team can do its best work at a sustainable pace

Balance personal delivery with team execution: step in on the complex work when your expertise is needed, while making sure the team keeps ownership and grows through the work

Build team capability, including the confident and responsible use of AI to raise both quality and pace
