raw.title: Client Complaint Senior Analyst
raw.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Client Services team as a Client Complaint Senior Analyst? Reporting to the Associate Director, Client Support you will take independent ownership of client complaints, using your judgement and complaints expertise to resolve non-routine cases fairly, effectively and within relevant requirements. You will support consistently high standards across complaint handling by identifying themes and improvements, sharing your knowledge and providing direct line management, day-to-day support and coaching to the Complaint Analyst.

Your role includes:

  • Independently manage client complaints from receipt through to resolution, applying sound judgement to deliver fair, timely and well-evidenced outcomes in line with complaint handling standards, relevant requirements and internal policies

  • Investigate non-routine complaints, bringing together information from systems, teams and stakeholders to establish root cause, reach appropriate conclusions and identify when complex matters require escalation

  • Produce clear, accurate and customer-focused written responses, ensuring decisions and outcomes are appropriately supported and communicated

  • Identify recurring complaint themes, risks and root causes, using insight from cases to suggest practical improvements to customer outcomes, service quality and complaint management processes

  • Take direct line management responsibility for the Client Complaint Analyst, setting clear objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, providing feedback and coaching, and supporting their onboarding, performance and development

  • Share complaints knowledge and best practice across the team while continuing to manage your own complaint caseload

  • Support consistent complaint handling standards across the team by providing guidance on day-to-day cases and constructively challenging where an approach may not achieve the right outcome

  • Build trusted relationships across Client Services, Financial Crime, Operations, Product and other relevant teams to resolve issues and support improvements that benefit customers and the Bank

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Strong working knowledge of complaint handling in a customer service, financial services, operations or regulated environment, with the ability to apply relevant processes, policies and controls independently

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including the ability to investigate non-routine issues, assess evidence, identify root causes and reach well-reasoned conclusions

  • Sound judgement, with the confidence to make day-to-day decisions independently and recognise when a more complex or higher-risk matter should be escalated

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and produce high-quality customer communications

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage varied complaint activity and competing priorities while maintaining quality and timeliness

  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to line manage the Complaints Analysts, set clear expectations, provide constructive feedback and coaching, and support their performance and development

  • Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, challenge constructively and suggest better ways of working

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

raw.description:
People Analytics Analyst

About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly.

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

The role:

Reporting to our Head of People, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight.

Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team.

You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion.

  • Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control.

  • Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality.

  • Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations.

  • Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity.

  • Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action.

  • Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust.

  • People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support.

  • Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation.

  • Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets.

  • Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations.

  • Strong Excel / Databricks capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome.

  • Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs.

  • Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information.

  • Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools. Notable; Databricks.

  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis.

  • Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data.

  • Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation.

  • Build trust together: Take ownership of data quality and delivery, follow through on commitments, exercise sound judgement and raise risks or limitations early.

  • Grow with the challenge: Stay curious, seek feedback and build analytical capability while adapting to changing priorities and new questions.

  • Succeed as one: Work collaboratively across People, Reward, Finance, Payroll and the wider business, engaging stakeholders early and focusing on shared outcomes.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve.

raw.description:
People Analytics Analyst

About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly.

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

The role:

Reporting to our Head of People, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight.

Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team.

You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion.

  • Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control.

  • Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality.

  • Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations.

  • Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity.

  • Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action.

  • Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust.

  • People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support.

  • Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation.

  • Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations.

  • Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets.

  • Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations.

  • Strong Excel / Databricks capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome.

  • Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs.

  • Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information.

  • Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

  • Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools. Notable; Databricks.

  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis.

  • Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data.

  • Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes.

  • Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve.

raw.title: Senior Director, Marketing
raw.description:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director, Marketing to own the whole marketing function across demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, with accountability for pipeline contribution, the market narrative, and the marketing budget. The team is seven people across the US and UK. You will set direction, connect marketing to the commercial number, and run as one go-to-market unit with our (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

Based in London or New York, with regular travel across the US and Europe.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and lead the full marketing function: demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, including the team across the US and UK and the complete marketing budget.

  • Bring the team together with a clear marketing plan and operating rhythm, and connect the function to the commercial number.

  • Own an agreed and evidenced marketing contribution to pipeline, reported consistently and trusted by sales leadership and the board. Run the function off numbers: pipeline sourced and influenced, conversion by stage, cost per opportunity and programme return.

  • Refresh positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across marketing, sales and product, so the same story is told the same way.

  • Hold and defend the full marketing budget. Make real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, reallocate on evidence, and show what each dollar returned and what was stopped.

  • Lead and coach the team. Retain and stretch top performers, set clear expectations, and shape the team structure around the plan.

  • Build a measurably stronger share of voice in cyber risk analytics across insurance and reinsurance media, analysts, and industry events.

  • Run marketing across US and European markets. Judge where a global message holds and where it has to flex, and manage a team split across time zones without defaulting to one side.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Product, and run as one go-to-market unit with the (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

What We Look For

  • Proven marketing leadership across all three pillars: demand generation, product marketing and communications/events, with a team of comparable size and seniority. Has set the plan, allocated a budget and been held to a pipeline number.

  • Has marketed complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers in a B2B SaaS or analytics business. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs. Understands how marketing creates and accelerates enterprise pipeline rather than reporting on it.

  • International experience. Has run marketing across US and European markets and managed a team split across time zones.

  • Budget ownership. Has held and defended a full marketing budget, made real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, and can evidence return.

  • Metrics-oriented. Runs the function off numbers and is comfortable being inspected on them alongside sales. Knows the funnel numbers without looking them up and coaches the team against them. Stops what is not working quickly and moves the budget to what is.

  • Product marketing judgement. Can shape positioning and messaging for a technical analytics product and hold the line on the narrative across sales, product and comms.

  • Commercially accountable. Volunteers for the number rather than negotiating away from it, and is as comfortable in a forecast review as in a creative one. Not precious about which activities get prioritised, and agile enough to change them as the company scales.

  • Executive credible. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to carry the CyberCube story.

  • A high accountability people leader who raises the bar on an existing team. Sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, and is respected for it.

  • Strong editorial judgment and taste. Will not ship undifferentiated content, and can tell the difference between a message that resonates with the market and one that only resonates internally.

  • Partners with Sales and Product by choice, not by process. Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.

  • Based in London, with regular international travel across the US and Europe.

 

Strong Plus

  • Has marketed into insurance, reinsurance or financial services. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, the Lloyd's market, banks or asset managers. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.

  • Experience marketing alongside a direct enterprise sales team with named accounts, including account-based marketing into a defined target list.

  • Has built or materially raised a brand in a category that needed defining rather than one that already existed.

  • Has run a flagship industry event presence and an executive speaking programme, and can judge which events are worth the money.

  • Analyst and media relations experience, and comfort with thought leadership built on proprietary data.

  • Has scaled a marketing function through a step change in growth expectations.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. AI-assisted content production, agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Research shows the best candidates rarely match a job description point for point. If you're excited about this role and believe you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything listed above.

CyberCube Analytics, Inc. and CyberCube Analytics Europe Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t tolerate discrimination against age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, veteran status, protected genetic information or political affiliation.

Compensation: $180K – $255K • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges

  • New York • Estimated Base Salary $180K – $255K • Offers Bonus
  • London • Estimated Base Salary £120K – £165K • Offers Bonus

raw.title: Warehouse Supervisor - Manchester
raw.description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Manchester (M12)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Manchester team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation and causal inference.

We're hiring multiple Data Science Managers across different areas of the business. All of these roles are at the same level. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope and team at the end of the process, based on your background, interview performance, preferences and current business needs.

You only need to submit one application, as we'll consider your profile across all suitable Data Science Manager vacancies. Before an offer is made, you'll have the opportunity to meet the proposed team, either virtually or at our London headquarters, and learn more about the role's scope and priorities.

 

What You'll Be Doing

You'll own the analytical direction and measurable impact of a product or business area, while leading and developing a high-performing team of data scientists or machine learning engineers.

Our Data Science Managers work across a range of consumer, product and commercial areas. Depending on the team you join, your work could focus on areas such as customer retention and loyalty, pricing and promotions, discovery and personalisation, or customer acquisition and engagement.

Across all roles, you'll lead and develop your team, set the analytical direction for your area and decide which problems are worth solving. You'll ensure data science work translates into better product and commercial decisions, not just analysis.

You'll remain hands-on while managing a team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Ops, Marketing and Finance as a thought partner. You'll set the bar for analytical rigour, prioritisation and impact across noisy metrics, real trade-offs and strong stakeholder opinions.

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience line managing data scientists and supporting their career development

  • A strong background as a senior individual contributor, with hands-on experience in experimentation, causal inference or applied machine learning

  • Proven ability to identify high-impact opportunities and turn insights into clear strategy and execution

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where prioritisation and judgement matter as much as technical skill

Our Analytics community is highly active, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you'll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

 

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering "did this feature work?" and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

  • Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

  • Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

  • Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

  • Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

  • Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

  • Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Familiarity with SQL

  • Excellent people skills as you will be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash's regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance.

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash's regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. 
  • Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Analytics Organisation

We have an outstanding analytics organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making.

Our community is highly active, with guest lectures, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process. Data Scientists can progress equally as technical leads or people managers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What is the impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

  • How do we optimise our compensation policy to keep our customers happy and ordering with Deliveroo?

  • How much should our pricing vary by distance and by market?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants in a particular area?

  • How do we adapt our consumer app to better suit grocery shoppers?

  • Significant experience in Data Science (or similar) roles.

  • Experience leading both simple and more complex experiment designs, with the ability to proactively unpick insights to steer strategic decision making

  • Great communication skills - in person, in writing, in code; to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Through solid analysis, provide clear and actionable recommendations that influence the team's roadmap.

  • Effective problem-solving, demonstrating an ability to successfully address complex and ambiguous challenges.

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL. Proficiency with Cursor/AI tools to deliver impactful, high-quality work efficiently is also valued

  • A pragmatic, flexible approach, where you most care about achieving impact

  • Excellent people skills — you'll be meeting with a range of both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories.


What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact.

  • Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end.

  • Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience.

  • Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships.

  • Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases.


What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets.

  • Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

  • Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

  • Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention.

Nice to Have

  • Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows.

  • Data Structure Familiarity: Experience working alongside Catalog or Search product areas to power front-end surfaces with complex item data.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.description:
Travel is essential, whether it's visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career-defining trip. Yet over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we're rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we're simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer, you’ll help solve a uniquely rewarding challenge: making travel disruptions easier for everyone involved. When plans change unexpectedly, travellers need fast, clear answers, while the businesses that sold them the trip need to stay in control. You’ll design our AI support product end-to-end, shaping the experience for both the travel businesses using Duffel (B2B) and the travellers they serve (B2C).

Working closely with product, engineering, and operations, you’ll champion design across Duffel, helping define what great looks like and elevating the craft of our products as a whole. To thrive in this role, you’ll bring experience designing complex products from start to finish and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring those ideas to life.

What you'll be doing

  • Own end-to-end design for our AI support product, from discovery and flows to prototypes and shipped software, in a product where airline rules, payments and customer expectations all collide.

  • Run discovery with customers and the travellers they serve, and turn needs from multiple stakeholders into clear, prioritised requirements.

  • Be the voice of design at Duffel: set and uphold the quality bar across craft, accessibility and consistency, and raise it in every review.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Product Managers and engineers to take designs through to delivery, then learn from real usage and feedback quickly.

  • Explain the why behind every design decision, welcome challenge from anyone, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Design how AI and people work together: what the AI should do, when it hands over to a human, and how users understand, trust and correct it.

  • Bring ideas from other products and industries to Duffel, and share them so the whole team's design thinking improves.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows you've taken a complex product from problem to shipped outcome and can say what changed because of it.

  • Strong craft across interaction, visual and systems design: you ship the states, edge cases and accessibility, not only the happy path.

  • Experience working with several stakeholder groups at once, ideally both business customers and end consumers, and a clear method for turning their conflicting needs into decisions.

  • Experience designing AI, conversational or support products, and an understanding of what makes them hard: uncertainty, failure states, trust and handover to humans.

  • A close working relationship with engineers and PMs, including prototyping in code or with AI tools where it speeds up learning.

  • A collaborative mindset with a strong point of view: you push back with evidence, take feedback well and can articulate the why behind any design.

  • The confidence to hold a quality bar and speak for design across the company. You influence without authority and you're happy to set the example.

What you'll be working on

  • Designing the experience of an AI support agent that answers travellers and hands over to our travel support team when it should.

  • Defining the patterns for AI behaviour: when it acts, asks, escalates or defers, and how users see what it did and why.

  • Building tools for the businesses on Duffel to review, correct and trust what the AI does on their behalf.

  • Helping other teams with their design needs when they ask, and sometimes when they don't yet know they have one.

  • Sharing design progress, rationale and open questions weekly with product, engineering and operations,

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption)


The Details

📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays).

🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent: (change accordingly to role)

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Hiring Manager Chat

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Stage Interview

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 £30,000 - £35,000 + £8,400 OTE + Benefits

Our Account Executive role is the first step in your career within Sales @ Funding Circle! Here you will learn the foundations of sale starting with a tailored two week Sales Induction Programme on joining. From there, you will be given the on-going tools and support to thrive in your role and eventually progress into more senior roles such as Account Manager, all the way through to Sales Team Manager!

Our Account Executive roles are phone based and are the first point of contact with our Borrowers; speaking with them frequently during their Funding Circle journey. Every day you will speak to a diverse range of SME business owners to gain an understanding of their business, find out about their goals and explain how Funding Circle can help in achieving them.

  • Working with warm leads to generate new opportunities through business development of existing Funding Circle borrowers (c.60-80 dials per day)

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of creating an application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Proactively problem solving, identifying and confidently mitigating any risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Experience working in a sales or service environment - we don’t require heaps of experience but some exposure to a sales or service environment is beneficial

  • A strong communicator, confident to be able to engage with small business owners over the phone and via email

  • You’re able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

  • Ability to continually develop and maintain your pipeline whilst managing applications in progress Proactivity and a desire to develop your career and taking onboard feedback - continuous development is a key part of sales at Funding Circle and we are looking for people keen to grow!

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

This is a senior leadership role designed to reset what Design does at Funding Circle, how it executes, and how it partners with the rest of the company.

  • Partner alongside our VP of Product and VP of Engineering to reset our operating model, taking joint accountability for how we build great solutions for our customers

  • Take ownership of our hardest experience problems, working within heavy regulatory constraints to make the complex lending journey from application to servicing feel simple, honest, and joined up for time-pressured business owners

  • Move design upstream to ensure it has a powerful voice in discovery and strategy, demonstrating the true value of design thinking rather than just rendering decisions that have already been taken

  • Set the standard and mechanisms for design excellence across the company defining the format, cadence, and ownership needed to ensure we are proud of the experience we give to our customers

  • Support, nurture, and hire the best design talent to successfully execute our strategy

  • Act as a senior, hands-on leader who is able to actively steer, shape and deliver on our most important strategic bets

  • Drive a significant improvement in how we solve our customers' problems and deliver the tangible business results that follow

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Experience leading design in complex, highly regulated environments like fintech

  • Skills in turning dense rules, Risk, and Compliance constraints into simple, intuitive journeys

  • A strong partner to senior Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, scope work, and influence roadmaps

  • Exceptional hands-on craft. You know what ‘good’ looks like and can coach senior talent to achieve it

  • Commercial focus, using data and research to tie design directly to business outcomes

raw.title: Legal Engineer, Custom Solutions
raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview


Harvey's Custom Solutions team builds tailored AI tools for leading strategic customers. The team scopes, designs and implements custom agents, playbooks and prompts to address high-priority use cases. Each solution is built around a customer's specific needs and stored in its Harvey instance for scalable access across the organization. Team members have opportunities to travel onsite and build relationships with senior stakeholders to support the rollout of these tools. They also partner with Harvey's Go-to-Market and Product teams to advance the platform by gathering feedback, surfacing opportunities and piloting features.


What You'll Do

  • Establish a clear understanding of Harvey's platform and the process for building solutions (you're not expected to be a platform expert on day one, but you should be interested in becoming one).

  • Scope, design and build custom agents, playbooks and prompts for key strategic customers.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders to understand their requirements, map their processes and turn needs into working solutions.

  • Prototype, test and iterate, including piloting Harvey features prior to general release.

  • Communicate market feedback to Product and Engineering, surfacing the opportunities for enhancements that will be most impactful.

  • Partner with Harvey's other Legal Engineering and Go-to-Market teams to deliver measurable growth.

  • Create and maintain reusable assets, capturing best practices to speed up future deployments.

What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales

  • 3+ years of experience as a practicing lawyer at a top-tier firm and/or in-house legal team.

  • Curiosity about testing various approaches, evaluating deliverable quality and optimizing for customer outcomes and experience.

  • Strong communication skills and a track record of partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results.

  • Interest in driving positive change in the legal industry through AI.

  • Experience using AI tools in legal practice is a plus.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview


Harvey's Custom Solutions team builds tailored AI tools for leading strategic customers. The team scopes, designs and implements custom agents, playbooks and prompts to address high-priority use cases. Each solution is built around a customer's specific needs and stored in its Harvey instance for scalable access across the organization. Team members have opportunities to travel onsite and build relationships with senior stakeholders to support the rollout of these tools. They also partner with Harvey's Go-to-Market and Product teams to advance the platform by gathering feedback, surfacing opportunities and piloting features.


What You'll Do

  • Establish a clear understanding of Harvey's platform and the process for building solutions (you're not expected to be a platform expert on day one, but you should be interested in becoming one).

  • Scope, design and build custom agents, playbooks and prompts for key strategic customers.

  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders to understand their requirements, map their processes and turn needs into working solutions.

  • Prototype, test and iterate, including piloting Harvey features prior to general release.

  • Communicate market feedback to Product and Engineering, surfacing the opportunities for enhancements that will be most impactful.

  • Partner with Harvey's other Legal Engineering and Go-to-Market teams to deliver measurable growth.

  • Create and maintain reusable assets, capturing best practices to speed up future deployments.

What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales

  • 3+ years of experience as a practicing lawyer at a top-tier firm and/or in-house legal team.

  • Curiosity about testing various approaches, evaluating deliverable quality and optimizing for customer outcomes and experience.

  • Strong communication skills and a track record of partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results.

  • Interest in driving positive change in the legal industry through AI.

  • Experience using AI tools in legal practice is a plus.

Role Overview

As a Sales Development Representative at Harvey, you will be at the forefront of driving the growth and adoption of our AI solutions across the legal and professional services markets. You will own early-stage pipeline creation across EMEA by engaging law firms, professional services organizations, and in-house legal teams, understanding their unique challenges, and introducing Harvey’s AI platform.

This role combines highly personalized outbound prospecting with thoughtful inbound qualification. Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, paired with curiosity about AI and a rigorous approach to your work, will help us expand our reach and shape the future of knowledge work.

What You’ll Do

  • Build revenue pipeline aligned with Harvey’s strategic customer profile using a variety of outbound tools and highly personalized outreach.

  • Proactively prospect into target accounts across EMEA through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other creative outbound strategies.

  • Source and qualify new sales opportunities through both outbound prospecting and inbound lead follow-up.

  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand customer workflows and determine strong opportunities for the sales team.

  • Respond quickly to inbound interest and ensure timely qualification and follow-up.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop opportunities and support early-stage deal progression.

  • Provide data-driven insights to inform sales strategies and improve prospecting effectiveness.

  • Contribute to developing Harvey’s sales playbook and document learnings as we scale the team globally.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed qualified pipeline and activity targets.

What You Have

  • 1–2+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in sales development or project management.

  • Fluent in written and spoken English and German.

  • Strong executive presence and comfort presenting to sophisticated executive buyers.

  • Independent, driven, and approach work with rigor and thoughtfulness.

  • Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Proficient with Salesforce, Salesloft, and reporting tools.

  • Collaborative team player able to work across internal functions.

  • Passionate about Harvey’s mission with a strong understanding of AI applications in knowledge work.

  • Interest in the legal profession; experience in the legal industry is a plus but not required.
