raw.title: Senior Director, AI Creative Operations
raw.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Senior Director for AI Creative Operations (UK/EMEA) will lead the practical evolution of AI-powered creative operations across the region, working across Strategy, Creative, Production, Delivery, Product and Commercial teams to redesign workflows and operating models around the opportunities AI and agentic technology create.

This requires a deep understanding of how creative design and production work end to end, from briefing and creative development through to production, adaptation, localisation and delivery. The role will identify where processes can be simplified, automated, connected or reconfigured through Pencil and agentic workflows, while protecting creative quality and commercial effectiveness.

Crucially, this is not about imposing a single production model across every client. It is about understanding different client requirements, systems, processes and ways of working, then designing the right combination of people, technology and workflows to deliver effectively within each environment.

The role will turn these opportunities into practical, repeatable and commercially effective solutions, working with regional delivery teams and the wider Global Production Capability to validate approaches, embed new ways of working and scale proven models across clients and markets.

 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

 

AI Delivery Excellence

  • Lead the development of scalable AI creative workflows, operating models and delivery standards across Jellyfish.

  • Optimise end-to-end workflows, identifying friction, duplication and manual processes that limit speed, quality or scalability. Driving connection and coordination cross Pencil to ensure we are aligned on a connected product roadmap and creative excellence in our delivery.

  • Establish best practices for AI-powered creative origination, design, production, adaptation, versioning and localisation.

  • Validate workflows in real client environments, ensuring solutions perform as promised before wider rollout.

  • Embed appropriate AI governance, quality assurance, risk management and client compliance standards.

Commercial Optimisation

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce operational overhead and increase margin through AI.

  • Analyse workflows to understand where time, cost and resource are being spent, translating findings into actionable improvements.

  • Measure the impact of AI adoption on productivity, delivery performance, profitability and client value.

  • Build scalable delivery models that enable Jellyfish to increase output and capability without simply increasing resource.

  • Ensure AI-enabled efficiencies translate into tangible commercial benefits rather than additional operational complexity.

Product & Technology Enablement

  • Connect delivery teams with Pencil and wider Product and Technology teams, translating real-world challenges into actionable product feedback.

  • Establish structured feedback loops between client delivery, creative teams and product development to inform roadmaps and prioritise improvements.

  • Lead the testing and validation of new tools, features and beta programmes against real creative and operational requirements.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve integration between platforms, tools and delivery environments.

  • Champion practical adoption of AI capabilities, ensuring technology solves real problems and delivers on its intended value.

Client & Growth Enablement

  • Equip client and creative leaders to confidently articulate the value of AI-powered creative solutions.

  • Support strategic pitches, executive consulting and client adoption programmes, demonstrating how AI can transform creative delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships through new AI-enabled services, operating models and commercial propositions.

  • Resolve delivery challenges that risk client confidence, ensuring the experience matches the promise.

  • Turn successful implementations into compelling case studies and repeatable solutions that support growth across Jellyfish.

Continuous Improvement & Global Standards

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, using delivery data, team feedback and client outcomes to drive meaningful change.

  • Codify successful workflows into practical playbooks, frameworks and global standards that teams can adopt and adapt.

  • Capture and share learnings, benchmarks and success stories across markets, clients and capabilities.

  • Establish clear methods for identifying, prioritising and resolving recurring operational issues.

  • Scale proven approaches globally while allowing flexibility for different clients, markets and creative requirements.

Creative Talent, Resource & Capability Development

  • Partner with Delivery Leads across Production and Social to evolve talent, skills and resource models in line with the changing demands of AI-powered delivery.

  • Optimise resource allocation across teams and disciplines, ensuring talent is deployed effectively against client demand, business priorities and emerging AI-enabled workflows.

  • Identify capability gaps, future skills requirements and opportunities to develop talent as agentic workflows reshape creative production and social delivery.

  • Inspire creative and delivery teams to explore how technology can amplify campaign ideas, unlock new creative possibilities and improve execution.

  • Develop practical enablement programmes that build confidence and capability in AI-powered creative workflows.

  • Identify where specialist support, training or new capabilities are needed to accelerate adoption and improve delivery.

  • Protect valuable creative and strategic time by reducing avoidable troubleshooting and ensuring teams can focus on high-value client work.

Leadership Qualities

  • Strategic and operational: Able to connect global business priorities with practical changes that improve day-to-day delivery.

  • Commercially minded: Understands how workflow design, resource utilisation, productivity and technology translate into business performance.

  • AI and technology fluent: Understands the evolving AI creative landscape and can translate technical capabilities into meaningful business solutions.

  • Creative by instinct: Recognises that technology should amplify creative ambition, not simply make existing processes faster.

  • Collaborative and influential: Builds strong relationships across Creative, Delivery, Product, Technology, Commercial and Client teams.

  • Analytical and solutions-focused: Uses evidence and insight to identify root causes, challenge existing approaches and drive measurable improvements.

  • Change-oriented: Can bring teams with them, turn experimentation into adoption and embed new ways of working across a global organisation.

     

Goals for Evolution

  • Establish AI Creative Operations as a global capability within Jellyfish Creative Delivery.

  • Move from fragmented AI adoption to consistent, scalable and commercially effective delivery models.

  • Create a robust feedback loop between client delivery and Pencil Product teams, ensuring product development reflects real-world needs.

  • Establish a measurable framework for AI delivery performance, productivity, quality and commercial impact.

  • Build a library of proven workflows, playbooks and case studies that accelerate adoption across clients and markets.

  • Position Brandtech as a leader in AI-powered creative delivery, connecting creative excellence, technology and measurable business value.

     

Qualifications:

  • Significant experience leading creative operations, creative production, delivery transformation, marketing technology or AI-enabled workflows within a global creative, marketing or technology-led organisation.

  • Demonstrable understanding of generative AI and its practical application across creative development, production, adaptation and delivery.

  • Experience translating complex workflows into scalable operating models, with a strong track record of driving adoption and continuous improvement.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with delivery economics, resource utilisation, productivity and margin improvement.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, creative and client-facing teams to improve technology-enabled delivery.

  • Ability to interpret operational data, identify opportunities and translate insights into measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and bring global teams together around change.

  • A genuine passion for creativity, innovation and the role technology can play in unlocking better work and better business outcomes.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

  • Own outbound prospecting with guidance. Build and run targeted outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone to open first conversations.

  • Qualify opportunities. Run structured discovery using a guide to assess fit against our ICP.

  • Nurture leads. Follow up with clear value and next steps to keep momentum moving.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing. Align to campaigns and hand off cleanly to AEs.

  • Keep the pipeline clean. Log activity and notes accurately in Salesforce.

  • Surface market insight. Share what you hear so we can sharpen messaging and targeting.

  • Support events and campaigns. Engage leads before and after to drive real pipeline.

What You WIll Be Doing:

  • 1-2 years years experience in a BDR or SDR role. Internship or campus selling experience is also welcome.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Exposure to Outreach or similar is a plus.

  • Organized and able to manage multiple outreach streams.

  • Curious and coachable. You learn quickly and apply feedback.

  • Resilient and goal oriented. You move fast and do not let no slow you down.

  • Collaborative. You work well with AEs and Marketing and celebrate shared wins.

  • This is a London-based, 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.

What’s In It For You:

  • Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.

  • The opportunity to launch your GTM career at a legal AI company with true product–market fit.

  • Direct exposure to senior sales leadership and the chance to learn by doing: fast.

  • Structured onboarding, regular coaching, and clear paths for growth.

  • A fast-moving environment where your insights shape how we scale.

  • Competitive base salary, uncapped variable compensation, and equity upside.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France.

Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales.

What You'll Do

ER leadership and casework

  • Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard.

  • Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org.

  • Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment.

Compliance and jurisdictional risk

  • Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel).

  • Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early.

  • Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue.

  • Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards.

Team and capability building

  • Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team.

  • Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows.

Stakeholder partnership and consistency

  • Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day.

  • Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need.

  • Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership.

  • Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction.

  • A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure.

  • Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard.

  • Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard.

  • A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it.

  • The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck.

  • A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

You'll own a portfolio of Legora's consulting and SI partner relationships across Europe, working closely with their alliance leads, practice heads, and delivery teams, and with Legora's own sales and engagement teams, to turn those relationships into successful client outcomes.

We're building this program from the ground up in Europe — there's no inherited playbook here. You'll be one of the founding members of Legora's partnerships team on the ground, helping shape how we go to market with consulting partners in the region, what we ask of them, and what we give them in return. You'll work alongside the Director of Consulting Alliances and the broader partnerships team in New York, and closely with Sales, Engagement Management, and Legal Engineers in Europe.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of consulting and SI partners across Europe, from practice leads through to alliance stakeholders.

  • Map account and pipeline opportunities with partners, and get deals moving through co-sell and co-working motions with Legora's European sales team.

  • Get embedded with Legora's sales and customer teams so you understand the product well enough to demo it and speak to it credibly with partners.

  • Keep partner teams enabled and current as Legora's product evolves.

  • Identify issues in the partnership and team up with the Director to work through them.

  • Help shape the partnership model — what services partners provide, what Legora provides — working with the Director and internal teams.

  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, and bring partner and market feedback back into Legora.

What You Bring

  • Experience in alliances, partnerships, or business development at a SaaS or AI company. This means actual pipeline built, deals closed, and partner relationships that held up over time.

  • Firsthand experience with how consulting firms or SIs operate: how they make decisions and team with technology partners. We're looking for people who've been close to the strategy and delivery side of these relationships, not primarily an admin or coordination role within a large firm.

  • Comfort building a partner program rather than inheriting one. This means you're fine when the structure doesn't exist yet.

  • Good commercial judgment: you can work through multi-party deal complexity and know when to push and when to step back.

  • Ability to run multiple things at once (relationship, pipeline, enablement) across several partners simultaneously.

  • Strong communication across levels, from partner leadership to field teams.

  • Comfort with a product that ships fast — you'll stay current and help your partners do the same.

  • Willingness to travel to support partner relationships and joint customer work across Europe.

Nice to have:

  • Background in legal tech, professional services, or experience selling into law firms or in-house legal teams.

  • Familiarity with AI products and how to position them to buyers who are cautious about risk and care a lot about accuracy — this doesn't need to come from having worked at an AI company specifically; being a genuine, curious user of AI products counts.

  • Experience as an early hire on a partner team that scaled.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

You'll own Legora's partnerships with top law schools across Europe, working closely with faculty, school administration, and Legora's own sales and engagement teams, to get the next generation of lawyers trained on and excited about Legora.

You'll be one of the founding members of Legora's partnerships team on the ground, shaping how we bring Legora into legal curricula and how we build lasting relationships with the schools that matter most. You'll work alongside Legora's broader partnerships team in New York, and closely with Sales, Engagement Management, and Legal Engineers in Europe.

What You'll Do

  • Build and manage relationships with top law schools across Europe, getting students access to Legora through complimentary licenses.

  • Go beyond access — make sure students are genuinely learning on Legora, so they graduate as trained users and evangelists for the platform.

  • Team up with professors to embed Legora into the curriculum, identifying the faculty who are the real movers and shakers and figuring out what will get them excited about building a partnership around Legora.

  • Get embedded with Legora's sales and customer teams so you understand the product well enough to demo it and speak to it credibly with schools.

  • Track engagement and outcomes across your school partnerships, and report on progress.

  • Bring feedback from schools and faculty back into Legora to inform product and go-to-market decisions.

What You Bring

  • A law school background, ideally including experience at a large law firm, and some time spent actually practicing law.

  • Legal education and practice experience in Europe: you've studied and practiced law in the region and understand how European law schools and legal careers work.

  • A genuine interest in doing partnerships rather than continuing to practice law.

  • Comfort building a partner program rather than inheriting one. Meaning you're fine when the structure doesn't exist yet.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills as you'll be working with professors, school administrators, and students, as well as Legora's internal teams.

  • Ability to run multiple relationships and priorities at once, across several schools simultaneously.

  • Comfort with a product that ships fast — you'll stay current and help the schools you work with do the same.

  • Willingness to travel to visit schools and build relationships across Europe.

This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.

What you’ll do

  • Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.

  • Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes.

  • Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics.

  • Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.

  • Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform.

  • Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes.

  • Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.

  • Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.

What you bring

  • You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.

  • You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation presented as certainty.

raw.title: Commercial Analytics Manager
raw.description:
About Octopus Energy for Business

Octopus Energy for Business (OEB) is a rapidly scaling energy supplier with more than 130k business customers. We aim to accelerate the business sector’s transition to net zero whilst providing low-cost energy that meets the needs of our customers.

We’ve pioneered PPA-backed supply for mid-market businesses through Electric Match, led the way for SME smart tariffs with Shape Shifters and are the established market leader for enabling EV public charging through energy supply and services.

 

About the role

We’re seeking a highly skilled and data-driven Commercial Analytics Manager to modernise how we track and forecast our financial performance. In this role, you’ll take ownership of our business forecasting processes and lead the transition away from legacy, multi-tab spreadsheets. By leveraging modern data tools, you will build robust, automated pipelines to analyse margins, investigate variances, and provide actionable insights that optimise OEB's financial performance. You’ll collaborate closely with our Data team, finance teams, and senior leadership to ensure our financial strategies align with the company's sustainable growth objectives.


What you'll do

  • Provide consistent portfolio level reporting for OEB to determine overall net margins. This will include revenue, cost of sales, debt and operational expenditure.

  • Lead the development and management of the company’s forecast, ensuring accuracy and alignment with strategic goals.

  • Work with the team to interrogate the entire cost stack to influence pricing decisions.

  • Develop margin optimisation strategies, including pricing adjustments, cost reductions, and process improvements.

  • Improve accuracy of gross margin calculations in partnership with Finance and Pricing teams.

  • Lead meetings with colleagues and senior management to provide clear options in the decision making process.

  • Work closely with the pricing team to influence key decisions to ensure we provide customers with a wide range of tariffs which are set with a conscious view of outturned margins.

  • Provide monthly reporting packs to monitor different aspects of performance including budgets and variance analysis.

  • Work closely with business units to gather key inputs and assumptions for accurate forecasting.

  • Improve the tools behind our forecasting, moving away from spreadsheet-heavy processes towards Python and SQL-based analysis.

  • Compare forecasts with monthly actuals and thoroughly investigate variances across the business's book.


    • What you'll need

  • Strong proficiency in SQL to extract, manipulate, and transform complex commercial data.

  • Experience using Python for data analysis, automation, or financial modeling.

  • A minimum of 3 years experience of using data and coding to solve commercial, pricing, or financial problems.

  • A proven track record of untangling complex, legacy spreadsheet processes and replacing them with streamlined, automated solutions.

  • Strong financial acumen, particularly with reporting margins, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • The ability to bridge the gap between commercial finance and data analytics, summarising complex findings into clear narratives for senior, non-technical stakeholders.

  • A self-starter mentality with the confidence to take ownership of a growing area, solve complex problems, and constantly introduce new processes.

  • Ideally, previous financial, commercial, or pricing experience within the energy industry (considered a strong bonus, though we are open to exceptional data-driven candidates from other sectors).

    • Why else you'll love it here

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Senior Director of Social and Creator

Location: London, United Kingdom

Social is our largest and fastest-growing business on Unilever, one of the biggest marketers in the world. We're looking for a senior social leader to run it. 

You'll lead a team of 100+ social, content, community and creator specialists across U-Studio and our Social Studios, including Dove. The team works in-house, side by side with Unilever brand teams, on some of the most famous brands in the world. 

You'll be the figurehead for social on the account. You'll line manage senior leads, look after the careers of a large team across the UK, EMEA and our global hubs, and set the bar for what great Unilever social looks like. You'll partner closely with Global Client Leads and Managing Partners to grow the business, and you'll be the person Unilever's brand and business group leads turn to on social. 

THIS ROLE IS RIGHT FOR YOU IF:

You're a senior social leader who lives in the feed. You know platforms, audiences and culture, and you know what makes a post worth talking about. You can explain why to a CMO in two minutes. 

You've run large, multi-market teams and you care about the people in them. You've built teams that stay, grow and get promoted. 

You're commercially sharp. You've grown accounts, written winning proposals and owned the numbers as well as the work. 

You understand agency life inside out, but you're just as at home working inside a client's business. Unilever has many moving parts and many stakeholders. You enjoy that rather than putting up with it. 

You have a point of view on where social is going, and people want to hear it. 

ABOUT THE TEAM 

OLIVER has been Unilever's in-house agency partner since 2016. U-Studio now spans [18] markets and every business group. Social sits at the heart of it: content, community management, creators, social commerce and culture-led strategy across [90+] brands. In 2025 we became Social AOR for Dove, building One Dove Social Studios across [7] markets. 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING 

Leadership and people 

  • Lead and line manage the Unilever social leadership team, and set direction for social leads across every U-Studio and Social Studio. 
  • Own the careers of the wider team, including reviews, progression, hiring and retention. 
  • Be visible. Teams should know who sets the bar and why. 
  • Build a strong leadership bench underneath you, with clear succession for key roles. 
  • Represent social in the account leadership team. 

Clients and growth 

  • Be the senior social partner to Unilever brand, business group and global leads. 
  • Partner with Gareth and U-Studio leadership to grow social across new brands, markets and scope. 
  • Lead social thinking on proposals, pitches and renewals. 
  • Spot risks early in relationships, scope or quality, and act before the client raises them. 

Quality and craft 

  • Set and hold the creative and strategic bar for Unilever social everywhere we work. 
  • Own social playbooks and ways of working, and make sure they're rolled out and used in every market. 
  • Make sure brand strategy shows up in the feed, not just in the playbook. 
  • Embed GenAI tools, agents and proprietary tech in the team's everyday work. 

Thought leadership 

  • Develop our point of view on social for Unilever, covering platforms, culture, creators, social commerce and measurement. 
  • Bring new thinking to clients without waiting for a brief. 
  • Represent OLIVER at Unilever and industry events, working with the Global Head of Social on our wider social POV. 

Commercial and operations 

  • Own the health of the social business on Unilever, including resourcing, margin, utilisation and forecasting. 
  • Shape team structures and costing for new scope. 
  • Keep teams compliant with platform, regulatory and Unilever policy changes. 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING 

  • 12+ years in social at agencies or brands, including senior leadership of a large, international team. 
  • Experience leading senior relationships on a major global account, ideally FMCG or beauty. 
  • Deep platform knowledge and a strong creative eye. Editorial experience is a plus. 
  • A track record of line managing senior leaders and building teams that stay and grow. 
  • Commercial confidence with P&L, margin, resourcing and business cases. 
  • Experience working in a large, complex organisation with many stakeholders. 
  • Confident presenting to senior clients and industry audiences. 
  • Hands-on experience bringing AI into social workflows, or a real appetite to.

offer.title: Member of Technical Staff (Site Reliability Engineer, Crawler)

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff (Site Reliability Engineer, Crawler)
raw.description:
Keeping a crawler running is not the same as keeping it productive. Queues can grow while servers look healthy, and a small change can become a fleet-wide bottleneck. On Perplexity's Crawler team, you'll improve throughput, plan capacity, and build operational reliability through safer deployments, better observability, and durable fixes.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and optimize Kubernetes workloads and supporting infrastructure for crawler services, including fetching and rendering fleets.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, with safe rollouts, validation, and fast rollback.

  • Define SLOs and build monitoring, alerting, and observability for availability, latency, throughput, and resource saturation.

  • Own capacity planning and resource efficiency; diagnose queue backlogs, network failures, and resource bottlenecks with service owners.

  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation, lead incident response, and turn blameless postmortems into durable reliability improvements.

  • Write production software to automate diagnosis and routine remediation, with validation and approval gates for high-impact actions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or infrastructure-heavy backend roles, with strong programming skills in Python, C++, Rust, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, production Kubernetes, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and automated deployment workflows.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, and load balancing.

  • Experience building observability with tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana, and using SLOs to guide reliability improvements.

  • Proven experience diagnosing distributed-system failures, leading production incidents, and improving system performance or resource efficiency.

Nice to have

  • Experience operating web crawlers, search infrastructure, or browser fleets at scale.

  • Experience with distributed queues, backpressure, workload isolation, or multi-region recovery.

offer.title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)

raw.title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)
raw.description:
Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs.

  • Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes.

  • Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably.

  • Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors.

  • Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests.

  • Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++.

  • Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions.

  • Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits.

  • Knowledge of page lifecycle, network idle, service workers, client-side rendering, and shadow DOM; experience debugging JavaScript and fluency with Chrome DevTools, CDP, HAR files, curl, and packet captures.

  • Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined.

Nice to have

  • Experience developing CDN, caching, or web performance systems.

  • Experience operating crawlers, headless browsers, or distributed content-acquisition systems at scale.

  • Contributions to a browser engine or JavaScript runtime.

You will turn global engineering standards into flawless, repeatable daily routines, continually honing on-the-ground practices to keep our most advanced hardware running at peak performance. You will be part of the founding team standing up 24x7x365 on-site coverage at East London to meet tight customer SLAs, and as Radiant expands its EMEA footprint, your relentless drive for hardware perfection and proven field expertise with high-density environments will serve as the operational blueprint to scale execution models efficiently across the region.

What’s in it for you?

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Datacentre Operations Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

  • Exposure to industry-leading GPU and AI infrastructure

  • Opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly scaling global business

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive engineering culture

  • Real ownership and the ability to influence operational excellence

Hardware Operations & Break/Fix

  • Deploy and maintain HPC and AI hardware for uninterrupted operations, including hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, and component replacement

  • Execute break/fix procedures for advanced hardware platforms, including GPU module exchange, component-level fault isolation, and firmware-level diagnostics

Service & Operational Excellence

  • Prioritise and triage incident and smart-hands workload ensuring tight SLA coverage is maintained with a small on the ground team

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to stakeholders and customers

  • Champion a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willing to cross train and upskill in Infrastructure/Platform SRE practices

  • Willing to travel across EMEA to support future datacentre onboarding and train in new technologies

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Passion for hardware and upholding the highest operational standards on the ground

  • Strong communication skills in English

  • Proven hands-on experience with HPC/NVIDIA GPU platforms or equivalent high-density compute systems, high-performance storage, and networking

  • Practical knowledge of high-density air cooling systems—CRAC/CRAH operation, airflow and thermal monitoring, containment management, and associated maintenance—or strong related cooling infrastructure experience

  • Experience with, or demonstrable willingness and aptitude to train on, ultra-high-density compute platforms such as NVIDIA B300, busbar-based power distribution, or equivalent systems

  • Experience with and passion for management of compute at massive scale

  • Comfort operating a newly-onboarded OEM hardware platform, applying transferable knowledge from other high-density GPU/HPC OEM systems to ramp up quickly without direct prior exposure to this specific vendor

  • Familiarity with structured break/fix practices for complex hardware platforms, including module-level component exchange and firmware fault isolation

  • Expertise in hardware installation, network configuration, and low-level system maintenance, including firmware management

  • Knowledge of data centre environment technologies, including cooling and high-density power distribution

  • Understanding of capacity management principles: power, space, and cooling tracking

  • Strong understanding of hardware and spares management; ability to handle RMAs within defined SLOs

  • Understanding of HPC and AI workloads at a high level

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and resilience in a fast-paced environment

raw.description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

As Executive Assistant, you'll support members of Radiant's Leadership Team and keep the business running smoothly day to day, working alongside the Executive Assistant to our President & CEO.

You'll manage busy diaries, travel and meetings, organise team events, and be a trusted first point of contact for the leaders you support. You'll also cover for the CEO’s office when required.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-growing company, ideal for someone who is organised, proactive and loves making busy people's lives easier.

Key Responsibilities:

Support our leaders

  • Manage complex diaries for members of the Senior Leadership Team, prioritising time and resolving clashes.

  • Organise travel, visas and itineraries across the UK, Europe, India and the US.

  • Prepare meetings: agendas, papers, notes and follow-up actions.

  • Process expenses and handle day-to-day admin for the leaders you support.

Run meetings and events

  • Coordinate internal & external stakeholder meetings, and visits from customers and partners.

  • Organise team offsites & workshops, managing logistics, budgets, and vendors from planning through delivery.

Keep things running

  • Be the first point of contact for leadership enquiries, handling them with care and discretion.

  • Work with People, Ops and the office team on onboarding new leaders, office logistics and suppliers.

  • Cover for the Executive Assistant to the CEO when required.

  • Improve how we work: templates, processes and tools that save everyone time.

Qualifications:

  • Experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar role, supporting senior leaders or multiple executives.

  • Excellent organisation, with an eye for detail and the ability to juggle competing priorities.

  • Confident communicator, comfortable working with senior leaders, customers and partners.

  • Complete discretion with confidential information.

  • Proactive: you spot what's needed before you're asked.

  • Confident with Google Workspace, Slack and travel and expense tools.

  • Experience in a fast-growing, international business working across multiple timezones.

What You Bring:

  • Organisation: You keep many plates spinning, and none of them drop.

  • Anticipation: You think a step ahead of the people you support.

  • Discretion: You handle sensitive information with care.

  • Service: You make busy people's lives easier, and enjoy it.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for getting things done, start to finish.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

  • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cut-offs, exceptions and risks so that employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Apply a strong understanding of legislation, statutory requirements and payroll practice across multiple jurisdictions, keeping processes compliant and appropriately controlled.

  • Act as the main point of contact for external payroll providers and Employer of Record partners, holding them to agreed service levels.

  • Resolve employee payroll queries promptly and clearly, escalating complex cases where needed.

  • Support internal and external audits, providing accurate documentation and evidence of controls.

Benefits

  • Administer employee benefits across all countries, including pension, health insurance, life assurance and other local schemes.

  • Manage annual renewals and open enrolment, and oversee joiner, leaver and life-event changes.

  • Partner with brokers and providers, benchmarking our offering against local market practice and supporting recommendations on benefits strategy.

  • Ensure benefits deductions and taxable benefits flow accurately into payroll and meet local reporting requirements.

  • Support the design and rollout of benefits in new countries as Radiant expands.

Systems and scaling initiatives

  • Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, using HiBob to automate workflows, optimise system configuration and build custom reporting.

  • Partner with local HR and Finance to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.

  • Identify and deliver process improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen controls and support onboarding of new entities.

  • Build and maintain clear payroll documentation, process maps and controls so the function can scale with the business.

Qualifications:

  • Significant experience running multi-country payroll end to end, ideally across the UK, Europe and the US.

  • Strong working knowledge of payroll legislation, tax and social security requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Hands-on experience administering employee benefits, including pensions and insured benefits.

  • Experience managing outsourced payroll providers and Employer of Record partners.

  • A track record of improving payroll processes and systems, with experience of HRIS and payroll platforms such as HiBob.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong controls mindset, with advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for reconciliations and reporting.

  • Clear, confident communication with employees, Finance and senior stakeholders.

  • Comfort working at pace in a fast-growing business, with the judgement to prioritise competing deadlines.

  • Discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential employee data.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

raw.title: People Partner
raw.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

The role

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

  • Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

  • Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers.

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

What you’ll do

  • Brainstorm ideas with stakeholders and help define early feature concepts

  • Express your design vision via wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and functional prototypes if necessary

  • Present and explain the rationale behind your design decisions on regular peer design review sessions. Collect feedback and quickly iterate.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure that your designs are accurately implemented according to Trading 212's standards of quality

  • Base your design decisions on data by leveraging Trading 212’s analytics tools and on user feedback by conducting usability tests

  • Evolve and maintain Trading 212’s design library

  • Drive innovation by integrating new tools and workflows into our design process.

  • Be autonomous and have full ownership of your work

 

What you'll need 

  • Expert knowledge of user-centric design principles and methodologies

  • Strong visual design skills, including layout, typography, and colour theory

  • Strong diagramming skills - you can reduce complex user flows into clean and easy-to-understand flowcharts.

  • Proven proficiency with Figma, Sketch, or other design tools.

  • Excellent collaborative skills - you can express your ideas verbally and in writing

  • An extensive portfolio that you can share with us

 

What we offer

  • Challenges that will help you grow and realize your potential.

  • Opportunity to make a big impact by building innovative services used by millions worldwide.

  • Work with smart, spirited, and high-performing colleagues with a common goal.

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas.

  • Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses.

  • Excellent social benefits package, including private health insurance, sports card, and 25 days of paid vacation per year.

  • Delicious treats and a spacious game room.Delicious treats and a spacious game room

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

raw.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.


You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up.

  • Familiarity with the UK region.

  • Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within the UK.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared

  • Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting.

  • Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator & Outreach

Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology.

  • Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including:

    • Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities.

    • Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement.

    • Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline.

    • Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale.

    • Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey.

    • Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value.

  • Focus on Solution-Driven Selling:

    • Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs.

    • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £87,000 GBP and £126,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The GTM Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across EMEA to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust.

You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role

  • 7+ years of experience in a B2B technology GTM organization across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, BDR, Enablement, frontline leadership, or a combination of these roles.

  • Experience carrying a quota, leading a frontline GTM team, or directly coaching customer-facing teams strongly preferred.

  • Strong business and analytical acumen, with demonstrated ability to diagnose performance problems, identify root causes, and turn insights into practical, measurable plans that improve skills, behaviors, and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of how to apply sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC in coaching, enablement, or field execution.

  • Credibility with frontline GTM leaders and sellers, built through curiosity, thoughtful discovery, and sound judgment, with the ability to operate independently as a coach, advisor, and constructive challenger.

  • High curiosity and fluency with AI, with experience using AI, automation, dashboards, and performance signals to make coaching more individualized, scalable, and measurable.
